notes.notes:
[p]

notes.title: Dimension Contest: Winter at the beach!
notes.notes: [p]Greetings, Ascended!  [/p][p]We welcome you to this month’s dimension contest, Winter at the Beach!  [/p][p] [/p][p]Summer’s heat may not be for everyone, and in times like these, we need refreshments and a change of scenery!  [/p][p]That’s right, this month’s dimension contest is all about blending two themes, summer and winter, to fight off the heat! [/p][p] [/p][p][b]How do I participate[/b]?  [/p][p] [/p][p]1. Get into RIFT and pick any of your favourite dimensions.  [/p][p]2. Decorate your dimension with the summer and winter themes in mind.  [/p][p]3. Take one or more screenshots of your creation and submit them in the #Winter-in-summer channel on the official RIFT Discord server, or use the #RIFTWinterNSummer25 hashtag on X or Facebook.  [/p][p]4. Be sure to include your Character Name, Shard, Region and Dimension Name.  [/p][p]5. You are good to go!  [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Are there any rules?[/b]  [/p][p] [/p][p]1. Feel free to use an existing dimension; however, do note that fresh and new decorations are always encouraged!  [/p][p]2. Your entry must adhere to the summer and winter theme.  [/p][p]3. Content that may be inappropriate or offensive is strictly forbidden.  [/p][p]4. Image editing is allowed as long as the entry is vastly visible.  [/p][p]5. Not including a Character Name, Shard, Region, or Dimension Name will make you ineligible to receive a reward.  [/p][p] [/p][p][b]What are the rewards?[/b]  [/p][p] [/p][p]The top three (3) participants will receive the following rewards:  [/p][p] [/p][p]1st place – Dimension Contest First Place + 3000 Credits   [/p][p]2nd place – Dimension Contest Second Place + 2000 Credits   [/p][p]3rd place – Dimension Contest Third Place + 1000 Credits  [/p][p] [/p][p]The entry period will conclude on September 30, 2025, 10:59 PM UTC, and winners will be announced on October 7, 2025.  [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Theme suggestion form![/b]  [/p][p] [/p][p]The Dimension theme suggestion form is still open!  [/p][p]If you have any fun ideas for a dimension contest, be sure to leave your suggestions there!  [/p][p] [/p][p]Click >[url="https://forms.office.com/e/DtdaJF19fA"]this link[/url]< and follow the instructions to help decide the next dimension contests!  [/p][p] [/p][p][url="https://www.trionworlds.com/rift/community/rift-terms-of-participation/"]General Terms of Participation apply.[/url]  [/p][p][url="https://riftgame.com/dimension-contest-winter-at-the-beach-detailed-information/"]Detailed Information[/url].[/p]

notes.title: Battle Pass: Tendril of Blight re-run!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, Ascended! 
Get ready for a season of blight and plentiful rewards, Tendrils of Blight is coming back! 
 
[b]What can I expect during Battle Pass: Tendril of Blight? [/b]
 
– Progress through 30 levels by completing daily and weekly quests and earn rewards. 
– 4 random Daily Quests (+2 for Patrons) per Day 
– 3 random Weekly Quests per Week 
 
Found a quest too difficult or perhaps too bothersome? The reroll feature is there for you! 
 
– 30 levels of rewards, split between Free, Premium and Patron! 
 
[b]Battle Pass Season 2 Rerun Duration? [/b]
 
The battle pass will stick around for a generous amount of time! 
 
Start: August 19, 2025 
End: January 26, 2026 
 
Duration: 160 Days[/p][p][b]Rewards[/b]

The Tendrils of Blight features the fantastical Wings of Life mount at level 30.
With this wonderful set of wings, throughout your bountiful journey, you may also expect bonus items and supply crates, as well as the artifact set “Like a Leaf on the Wind”, which grants the Leaf on the Wind title![/p][p]While Tendrils of Blight is here for a long time, it is not best to dally, head in-game on August 19th to get those quest done!

Your RIFT team.[/p]

notes.title: August 5, 2025 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[p]Here is the list of changes and fixes from the August 5, 2025, maintenance. 
 
[b]Seasonal Events[/b] 
 
- Fae Yule is now scheduled with the proper dates in-game. 
The 4-hour minion missions have been enabled for the duration of Fae Yule. 
 
- Autumn Harvest is now scheduled with the proper dates in-game. 
The 4-hour minion missions have been enabled for the duration of the Autumn Harvest. 
 
[b]Bug Fixes[/b] 
 
- Prismatic Planar Earrings and Prismatic Planar Earrings buffs for all callings now behave correctly when the character dies and respawns. 
(Previously, the buffs would disappear upon death, and the player would need to re-equip the earrings to allow the buffs to activate once more.) 
 
- The new capes from the July 22, 2025, patch are no longer dyeable. 
(When trying to dye the primary dye channel of any of the capes, the textures would disappear.) 
 
- Adjusted some images that looked distorted in the RIFT store. 
 
- Resolved an issue with the Object Distance setting not applying correctly. 
(RIFT’s object distance regulates itself with RAM usage, depending on the user’s machine capabilities – with this change, we have effectively increased the overall limit before RIFT self-regulates and reduces the object distance to favour smooth performance over pretty graphics. 
 
For low-end machines, Object Distance will continue to work as it has till now. 
Higher-end users will now see higher Object Distance more often due to the increased RAM limit usage cap – assuming the setting is set to the maximum of 180) 
 
[b]New Items[/b] 
 
Three new Ursin mounts and four new Tiger mounts have been introduced. 
These mounts will become available in RIFT in the following weeks. 
 
We thank you for your continued support! 
Your RIFT team [/p]

notes.title: Summerfest is back!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, Ascended! 
It’s been an entire year, but now it is finally time, Summerfest is back! 
 
[b]What is Summerfest?[/b] 
 
The origins of Summerfest are shrouded in mystery, but many scholars trace it back to ancient elven rituals involving burning sacrifices inside wicker figures. Today, most elves prefer to forget these barbaric aspects of their past, and such practices are now forbidden by both High Elves and Kelari, though occasionally referenced by disgruntled Dwarves. 

In modern Telara, Summerfest has evolved into a celebration of flames for all Ascended to enjoy. This holiday marks the longest days of summer and continues ancient traditions with a focus on fun, even in the sweltering heat. These festivities help lighten the mood and provide a distraction from the near-constant threats against Telara. 

[b]Activities aplenty![/b] 
 
But aside from its intriguing history, Summerfest has plenty of activities for you to enjoy, such as Scavenger Hunts, Swarmlord Khargroth Battles, Seasonal Quests, Artifact Pinatas and much more! 
 
Don’t hesitate Ascended, the Summerfest will pack up and leave on [b]July 30, 2025[/b], and its store will remain available until [b]August 6, 2025[/b], for all the Ascended who did not have quite enough time to buy all the gifts they wanted! 
 
Your RIFT team.[/p]

It’s that time of the year when we let the dogs out, literally!

notes.title: Dimension Contest: Ascended’s Haven!
notes.notes:
Hello, Ascended! 
Welcome to the Dimension contest: Ascended’s Haven! 
 
This month’s contest is all about you, where you are challenged to build your perfect safe place, a place where you yourself would spend hours of time in and is also a place that lets your personality shine through! 
 
[b]How do I participate? [/b]
 
1. Get into RIFT and pick any of your favorite dimensions. 
2. Decorate your dimension with the concept of building your very own safe place. 
3. Take one or more screenshots or your creation and submit it in the #Ascended-Haven channel on the official RIFT Discord server or use the #RIFTAscendedHaven hashtag on X or Facebook 
4. Be sure to include Character Name, Shard, Region and Dimension Name with your entry. 
5. You are good to go! 
 
[b]Are there any rules? [/b]
 
1. Feel free to use an existing dimension, however, do note that fresh and new decorations are always encouraged. 
2. Your entry must adhere to the theme of your own safe haven. 
3. Content that may be inappropriate or offensive is strictly forbidden. 
4. Image editing is allowed as long as the entry is vastly visible. 
5. Not including a Character Name, Shard, Region or Dimension Name will make you ineligible to receive a reward. 
 
[b]What are the rewards?[/b] 
 
The top three (3) participants will receive the following rewards: 
 
1st place – Dimension Contest First Place + 3000 Credits  
2nd place – Dimension Contest Second Place + 2000 Credits  
3rd place – Dimension Contest Third Place + 1000 Credits 
 
The entry period will conclude on June 6, 2025, 10:59 PM UTC and winners will be announced on June 13, 2025.

The Dimension theme suggestion form is still open! 
If you have any fun ideas for a dimension contest, be sure to leave your suggestions there!

notes.title: Mechs on Parade!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/2dcbd01e6a2733f4e7104b0a9b6c48ffc1b4e1b4.jpg[/img]

Hello Ascended!

Lightning can be heard reverberating throughout Telara, and the Mechs are back, causing the earth to tremble and creating mayhem wherever they set their gaze! Will you help defend Telara from these bulky armored enemies?

That’s exactly what we thought, Ascended. Sharpen your sword and your senses and strike back now! Starting today, take the siege to the Mechs for a chance to earn great rewards!

Head over to Sanctum (/setwaypoint 7380 3077), Meridian (/setwaypoint 6124 5231), or Tempest Bay (/setwaypoint 12944 11579) to accept Daily Quests and join Warfronts. Use the Looking For Group (LFG) tool to participate in Expert Dungeons, collect Mech Components, or join the zone event!

Completing all the daily quests will reward you with a total of 65 Chaos Motes per character every day!

The quest Defender of the Elements will take you to Vostigar Peaks, Silverwood, Freemarch, Shimmersand, and Stillmoor on a mission to defeat fearsome Mechs.

Stay sharp and bring your allies, Ascended; you may need them now more than ever!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/68cc6bc3c3889101281d551c0c28bf9f5fcfc017.png[/img]

Head over to the RIFT Store to get rewards for Credits or use your collected Chaos Motes at the event NPC to redeem amazing mounts, rewards, pets, and much more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/7aa3bae05cc11f8865f87d45663026ab00c318a6.jpg[/img]

Now is the time to strike, Ascended. Mechs will strike on [b]May 9, 2025[/b], and will retreat on [b]May 11, 2025, 23:59 UTC[/b]; be sure to keep them at bay until then before they wreak too much havoc!

See you in-game,
Your RIFT team!

notes.title: Dimension Contest: The Grand Medieval Clash!
notes.notes:

We welcome you to April’s dimension contest, The Grand Medieval Clash! 
 
This month’s theme is but one of the many player-suggested themes for a dimension contest, where you are challenged to build a medieval themed dimension, whether it be a grandiose castle, a king’s court or a busy tavern, the choice is yours for interpretation!

3. Take one or more screenshots of your creation and submit it in the #grand-medieval-clash channel on the official RIFT Discord server, or use the #RIFTMedievalClash24 hashtag on X or Facebook. 
4. Be sure to include your Character Name, Shard, Region and Dimension Name. 
5. You are good to go! 
 
[b]Are there any rules? [/b]
 
1. Feel free to use an existing dimension, however, do note that fresh and new decorations are always encouraged!

notes.title: RIFT’s Month of Love
notes.notes:
Hello, Ascended! 
Love is in the air, and we are no stranger to celebrating the month of love with you with some lovely activities! Starting today, join in the Lovely Dimension Contest to create the most charming dimension across Telara and/or capture a screenshot with your loved one for a chance to win fantastic prizes! 
 
[b]Dimension Contest: A lovely Home[/b] 💖🏡
 
This month’s dimension contest is all about crafting the most delightful dimension where love can blossom. Pink? Hearts? Up to you, just make it lovely! 
 
[b]How do I enter? [/b]
 
1. Select your favorite RIFT Dimension. 
2. Decorate the dimension following the theme of love. 
3. Capture one or more screenshots of your dimension and submit them to the #lovely-home-2025 channel on Discord or use the #RIFTLovelyHome2025 on Facebook or X. 
4. Don’t forget to include your Character Name, Shard and Dimension Name with your entry. 
5. You are good to go! 
 
[b]Are there any rules? [/b]
 
1. Feel free to use an existing Dimension, however, keep in mind the fresh decor is encouraged! 
2. Your entry must adhere to the theme of Love. 
3. Any content that may be offensive or inappropriate is not allowed. 
4. Image editing is allowed, as long as the entry remains vastly visible. 
5. Not including Character Name and Shard with your entry will make you ineligible to receive a reward. 
 
[b]What are the rewards? [/b]
 
The top three (3) participants will receive the following rewards: 
 
1st Place – Dimension Contest First Place + 3000 Credits 
2nd Place – Dimension Contest Second Place + 3000 Credits 
3rd Place – Dimension Contest Third Place + 3000 Credits 
 
Entry period will close on March 3, 2025, 22:59 UTC and winners will be announced on March 11, 2025. 


[b]Screenshot Contest: A Lovely Duo 💞[/b]
 
If dimensions are not your style, then worry not, we have something for you and your loved one to take part in as well! 
 
Take part with your significant other to conquer Telara through sheer power of love and win amazing rewards! 
 
[b]How do I participate?[/b] 
 
1. Head over to Telara with your loved one. 
2. Pick out your favorite attire, matching or not, show us your personalities! 
3. Strike a pose and take a screenshot! 
4. Submit your entry to the #lovely-duo-2025 Discord Channel or use the #RIFTLovelyDuo2025 hashtag on Facebook or X. 
5. Include both Character Names and Shard in your entry. 
6. And you are both set! 
 
[b]Are there any rules?[/b] 
 
1. Your screenshot can be old or new, but newer pictures are encouraged! 
2. Your entry must contain at least one another playable character (maximum 2 players per entry) and must adhere to the contest’s theme of Love. 
3. Content and submissions that may be inappropriate or offensive are strictly forbidden. 
4. Image editing is allowed, as long as the entry remains fully visible. 
5. Entries that do not include either Character Names or just one Character Name and Shard will not be eligible to receive a reward. 
6. Once you submit an entry, your significant other is not required to submit another entry and submitting multiple will not increase the chances of earning a prize. 
 
[b]What are the rewards?[/b] 
 
Up to three (3) entries will be eligible to receive 3000 Credits for both characters in the screenshot. 
 
Entry period will conclude on March 3, 2025, 22:59 UTC and winners will be announced on March 11, 2025. 

[b]A Lovely Giveaway![/b] ❤️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/f31e42463a13ed09ac1e4ff817dc077789e4ecfa.jpg[/img]
Are you perhaps looking for a sweet new ride this Month of Love? Then we have a sweet treat for you! 
 
[b]How do I enter?[/b]
 
By simply participating in either A Lovely Home or A Lovely Duo you will be automatically entered in the raffle! 
 
[b]Is there anything I should know?[/b]
 
Should you participate in both contests, you will be eligible only for one raffle prize. 
Participating in both contests counts as 2 entries, one for each valid contest entry. 
 
[b]What is the reward?[/b] 
 
Up to three (3) contest participants will receive a Lovely Levitation mount! 
 
The contest runs along the two other contests until March 3, 2025, and the winners will be revealed on March 11, 2025. 

Head over to Telara, beloved Ascended, and show us what love truly means!

notes.title: A Magical RIFTmas 2024!
notes.notes:
Hohoho, Ascended! 
It’s that time of the year again, welcome to RIFTmas 2024, the most wonderful time of the year, packed with a ton of amazing rewards to make your RIFT adventure truly magical! 

-

[b]12 Days of Telara! [/b]


On the first day of RIFTmas, Cyril gave to me!~ 
That’s right, 12 Days of Telara is back with daily reward for everyone to enjoy until December 27, 2024! 
Truly exciting, is it not? Then be sure to turn in here every day to discover what new gift await you! 
 
[url=https://www.trionworlds.com/rift/en/?p=20915][b]Click here to check today's reward![/b][/url] 
 
Be sure to come around again tomorrow to discover a new surprise! 
 
[b]Some days may include raffle items, [url=https://forms.office.com/e/gjr0WatAzc]click here[/url] to become eligible! [/b]
[i]Note: Entry is required only once to be eligible for any raffle reward during 12 Days of Telara – submitting an entry multiple times with multiple characters and/or accounts is forbidden.[/i]

-

[b]Dimension Contest: A Cozy Winter Home 2024![/b]

The cold weather out there really got our hands in a cold predicament Ascended, and we need your help to warm our souls with some great Dimension decorations! 
 
[b]How do I enter? [/b]

[olist]
[*] Head over to RIFT and pick out your favorite snowy or cozy dimension. 
[*] Decorate it to your heart’s desire, but keep it warm and cozy! 
[*] Take one or more screenshots of your Dimension and submit it to the #cozy-winter-home channel on Discord or use the #RIFTCozyHome hashtag on Facebook or X! 
[*] Include your Character Name and Shard in your entry. 
[*] And you’re set! 
[/olist]

[b]Are there any rules? [/b]

[olist]
[*] Your Dimension can be old or newly made; however, newly decorated dimensions are encouraged! 
[*] Your entry must adhere to the contest’s theme “Warm and Cozy”. 
[*] Content that may be inappropriate or offensive is strictly forbidden. 
[*] Minor image editing is allowed. 
[*] Entries that don’t include Character Name and Shard will not be able to receive a reward.
[/olist] 

[b]What are the rewards? [/b]

Up to three (3) Ascended will receive the following rewards: 
 
1st place – Dimension Contest First Place + 3000 Credits 
2nd place – Dimension Contest Second Place +3000 Credits 
3rd place – Dimension Contest Third Place + 3000 Credits 
 
The contest submission period will end on January 5, 2025 and winners will be announced on January 15, 2025! 
 
Rewards may take up to two (2) weeks to be delivered from the winner’s announcement.

-

[b]RIFTmas Trivia![/b]

The fun doesn’t end with daily gifts and beautiful dimensions! 
Throughout 12 Days of Telara you can now take part in a fun trivia challenge to test your knowledge! 
 
To participate, [url=https://forms.office.com/e/n1BGV0vjZ5]simply click here[/url]! 
 
Up to nine (9) participants will receive 1000 Credits each! 
Winners will be announced on December 30, 2024!

-

[b]Screenshot Contest: RIFTmas in the snow![/b]

And now it’s your time to flex your photography skills! 
Take the perfect screenshot that perfectly pictures the spirit of the holidays to win amazing rewards! 
 
[b]How do I enter? [/b]
 
1. Head over to RIFT and take a screenshot that embodies the spirit of the holidays. 
2. One or more screenshots are allowed. 
3. Submit your entry to the #riftmas-in-the-snow channel on RIFT’s official Discord. 
4. Include your character Name, Shard and Region in your entry. 
5. And you’re good to go! 
 
[b]Are there any rules? [/b]
 
1. Your screenshot must adhere to the contest’s theme of RIFTmas. 
2. More than just your character can be present in the screenshot, however only the participant who submitted an entry is eligible for a reward. (Multiple of the same entry from separate users are not eligible) 
3. Image editing is allowed; however, your entry must remain fully visible. 
4. Entries that do not include Character Name, Shard and Region will not be eligible to receive a reward. 
 
[b]What are the rewards? [/b]
 
Up to three (3) Ascended will receive 3000 Credits each! 
 
The contest submission period will close on December 31, 2024 and winners will be announced on January 15, 2024. 

-

For all contests, [url=https://www.trionworlds.com/rift/community/rift-terms-of-participation/]General Terms of Participation Apply[/url].

notes.title: Autumnal Vibes!
notes.notes:
Hello, Ascended! 
It’s November and autumn can be felt in the wind, let’s take this occasion to build a warm dimension! 
 
This month’s dimension contest is all about autumn and it’s prominent colors such as orange and brown! Are you able to build the coziest autumnal retreat? 
 
[b]How do I participate?[/b]
 
1. Get into RIFT and pick your favorite dimension 
2. Decorate your dimension with the contest’s themes colors (autumn, orange, brown, green). 
3. Take one or more screenshots of your dimension and submit them to the #autumnal-vibes channels on Discord or use the #RIFTAutumnalVibes2024 hashtag on X (formerly known as Twitter) or Facebook. 
4. Include your Character Name, Shard and Region. 
5. You are good to go! 
 
[b]Are there any rules?[/b]
 
1. Feel free to use an existing dimension, but fresh decorations are encouraged!

[b]How can I access the PTS environment?[/b] 
 
To access the PTS environment, please do the following: 
 
1. Open Glyph and select RIFT. 
2. Click on the cogwheel icon on the right side of the Play button.

notes.title: RIFT EU Shard Closure Notice
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/f9a4e1d821f9bf0a321d6ea54303a6756df578d5.jpg[/img]

Hello, dear Ascended. 
 
We have some important news to share regarding the European Shards. 
On September 30, 2024, the European shard Bloodiron will be closed as part of our efforts to consolidate shards within the EU region. 
 
[b]Why are we closing the Shard? [/b]
 
Our goal is to make it easier for players in the European region to find fellow Ascended and embark on new adventures together. 
 
[b]What steps do I have to take if I am on Bloodiron? [/b]
 
1. If you are playing on the shard Bloodiron, please consider transferring to one of the following shards: Brisesol, Brutwacht or Typhiria. 
2. Read the guide on how to transfer your character(s) to another shard [url=https://support.gamigo.com/hc/en-us/articles/203372878-RIFT-Character-Transfer-Overview][b]by clicking here[/b][/url]. 
3. Keep an eye on the official RIFT website for more details. 
 
[b]What happens if I do not transfer in time? [/b]
 
Characters that are not transferred to Brisesol, Brutwacht or Typhiria before September 30, 2024, will become unavailable, and regular play will not be possible. We advise you to transfer to your preferred shard as soon as possible. 
 
[i]Please note that during this period, the character limit on the EU region will be lifted to facilitate transfers. [b]We recommend having no more than 14 characters on a single shard[/b]. If you exceed this limit, characters beyond the 14th will become inaccessible, and the only way to recover them is to delete some of your accessible characters. [/i]
 
We appreciate your continued support as we strive to ensure you can continue playing with other Ascended. 
 
Your RIFT team

notes.title: Summerfest is back!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/4d1f696b0ef967b83f910d1ad6e55f41a37426bc.jpg[/img]

Hello, Ascended! 
It’s been an entire year, but now it is finally time, Summerfest is back! 
 
[b]What is Summerfest?[/b] 
 
The origins of Summerfest are shrouded in mystery, but many scholars trace it back to ancient elven rituals involving burning sacrifices inside wicker figures. Today, most elves prefer to forget these barbaric aspects of their past, and such practices are now forbidden by both High Elves and Kelari, though occasionally referenced by disgruntled Dwarves. 

In modern Telara, Summerfest has evolved into a celebration of flames for all Ascended to enjoy. This holiday marks the longest days of summer and continues ancient traditions with a focus on fun, even in the sweltering heat. These festivities help lighten the mood and provide a distraction from the near-constant threats against Telara. 

[b]Activities aplenty![/b] 
 
But aside from its intriguing history, Summerfest has plenty of activities for you to enjoy, such as Scavenger Hunts, Swarmlord Khargroth Battles, Seasonal Quests, Artifact Pinatas and much more! 
 
Don’t hesitate Ascended, the Summerfest will pack up and leave on July 24, 2024, and its store will remain available until July 31, 2024, for all the Ascended who did not have quite enough time to buy all the gifts they wanted! 
 
[b]Known Issue[/b]: The in-game event time display is currently incorrect, and we are investigating. 
 
Your RIFT team.

notes.title: Important notice in regard to NA shards
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/7e4a5bde96f771c82ed7faeabdfacc719210019d.jpg[/img]

Hello, Ascended, 
we would like to share some important news regarding the shards Seastone, Faeblight and Hailol following our initial shard closure announcement. 
 
Starting today, the shards previously closed will become available to transfer characters to active shards until December 10, 2024. 
 
[b]Which shards are becoming available, and can I play on them?[/b] 
 
The NA Shards Seastone, Faeblight and Hailol are becoming available, but you will not be able to play on them, only transferring will be available during this transfer period. 
 
[b]Which shards can I transfer to?[/b] 
 
The available destination shards are Deepwood, Wolfsbane, Greybriar and Laethys. 
 
[b]How do I transfer? [/b]
 
Transferring is simple:  
 
1. Log in with the Glyph account, where your characters are located. 
2. Select and open the shard where your characters are found. 
3. Select the character you wish to Transfer. 
4. Click on “Transfer”. 
5. Select any of the 4 available shards and confirm. 
6. Your character will now be on an active shard and will be playable again. 

[i]We are aware that characters that have mails on their character cannot transfer. Therefore, please reach out per ticket.[/i]
 
How long do I have to transfer? 
 
The period to transfer from Seastone, Faeblight and Hailol is six months (until December 10, 2024). 
 
[b]We advise all players to move as soon as possible before the transfer period concludes. [/b]
 
Your RIFT team.

notes.title: RIFT NA Shards Merge Notice
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/96c13b06ecc97aacf6ccf1d20c7a4ccc57a9cedb.jpg[/img]

Hello, Ascended,

We’ve got some important news to share about Shard Merges for RIFT. As part of our ongoing efforts to create a more vibrant and populated world for you to explore and conquer, we’re taking steps to condense the shards within the NA region.

[b]Why merge Shards?[/b]

Our goal is to merge NA Shards, making it easier for you to connect with other fellow Ascended and dive into new adventures with ease.

[b]Which Shard will be merged?[/b]

Players of Faeblight, Hailol and Seastone must transfer to either Deepwood, Laethys, Greybriar or Wolfsbane until the 25th of March.

[b]What do I have to do?[/b]

[olist]
[*] Review Your Server: If you’re currently playing on Faeblight, Hailol, or Seastone, start considering a move to Greybriar, Wolfsbane, Deepwood, or Laethys.
[*] Please read the guide on how to transfer your Account to another Server. ([url=https://support.gamigo.com/hc/en-us/articles/203372878-RIFT-Character-Transfer-Overview]CLICK[/url])
[*] Stay Informed: Keep an eye on our official RIFT announcement for more details.
[*] What if I do not transfer in time?
[/olist]
Further details will be provided for those who may not transfer to Greybriar, Wolfsbane, Deepwood, or Laethys in time, ensuring your transition is as smooth as possible.

Stay tuned for updates and thank you for your continued support for RIFT.

Your RIFT Team.

notes.title: Unicornalia returns!

Unicornalia is back!
Participate in the ‘Hooves and Horns’ zone events associated with Unicornalia all over Telara and complete them to earn amazing rewards!

Pick up 4 Daily Quests from NPCs at the following locations:
Meridian (/setwaypoint 6122 5231), Sanctum (/setwaypoint 7380 3078) or Tempest Bay (/setwaypoint 12943 11579) to earn Chaos motes!

Chaos Motes are a special event currency that can be used to exchange amazing rewards such as special items and mounts like some of the ones below!

notes.title: Mechs on Parade!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/2dcbd01e6a2733f4e7104b0a9b6c48ffc1b4e1b4.jpg[/img]

Hello Ascended!

Lightning can be heard reverberating throughout Telara, and the Mechs are back, causing the earth to tremble and creating mayhem wherever they set their gaze! Will you help defend Telara from these bulky armored enemies?

That’s exactly what we thought, Ascended. Sharpen your sword and your senses and strike back now! Starting today, take the siege to the Mechs for a chance to earn great rewards!

Head over to Sanctum (/setwaypoint 7380 3077), Meridian (/setwaypoint 6124 5231), or Tempest Bay (/setwaypoint 12944 11579) to accept Daily Quests and join Warfronts. Use the Looking For Group (LFG) tool to participate in Expert Dungeons, collect Mech Components, or join the zone event!

Completing all the daily quests will reward you with a total of 65 Chaos Motes per character every day!

The quest Defender of the Elements will take you to Vostigar Peaks, Silverwood, Freemarch, Shimmersand, and Stillmoor on a mission to defeat fearsome Mechs.

Stay sharp and bring your allies, Ascended; you may need them now more than ever!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/68cc6bc3c3889101281d551c0c28bf9f5fcfc017.png[/img]

Head over to the RIFT Store to get rewards for Credits or use your collected Chaos Motes at the event NPC to redeem amazing mounts, rewards, pets, and much more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/7aa3bae05cc11f8865f87d45663026ab00c318a6.jpg[/img]

Now is the time to strike, Ascended. Mechs will retreat on November 27, 2023; be sure to keep them at bay until then before they wreak too much havoc!

See you in-game,
Your RIFT team!

notes.title: Head to the races for budgie days!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/5eb89c6b8cb373ff4640383e9a83b309e8c7a2ef.jpg[/img]

Hello Ascended!

Are you ready to welcome back your feathered friends? We sure hope you are because the Budgies are back!

Starting today, complete special daily quests to earn Chaos Motes, which can be exchanged for some great mounts and rewards!

You can find the quest givers in Meridian (/setwaypoint 6122 5231), Sanctum (/setwaypoint 7380 3078), and Tempest Bay (/setwaypoint 12943 11579)!

If you’re heading to the race, here are a few tips and tricks:

✨ Stay within the marked path.
🐦 Hit all the white checkpoints throughout the race.
🚀 Use all the green boosts to increase your speed and leave your opponents behind!
🐌 If you prefer speed over slow, avoid all orange traps!

Remember, a clear mind makes the goal clear. Stay focused, and you too can win the race, Ascended!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/5def2f12d0d04796b739119b282c84576312d009.png[/img]

Budgie Madness will end on November 23, 2023, so hurry up and collect as many of those feathered cuties as you can!

Your RIFT team!

notes.title: Autumn Snapshot Showdown: Go Nuts in RIFT!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/08f20c30eda982119fdfeead01398068a290c077.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Ascended!
Autumn is in full swing, and there’s no better time than now to partake in a fun challenge for a chance to win a great reward!

Starting today, and running until November 29, 2023, enter our contest on [url=https://gleam.io/xmOzD/rift-autumn-snapshot-showdown-go-nuts]Gleam.io[/url]. Take on as many different challenges as possible to increase your chances of winning one of the three “Wraps the Mummified Squirrel” prizes!

[b]Autumn Snapshot Showdown: How do I enter?[/b]

Participating in the screenshot contest is simple. Follow the steps below:

[olist]
[*] Head over to RIFT and take a screenshot of your favorite landscape that reminds you of the autumn season.
[*] Open [url=https://gleam.io/xmOzD/rift-autumn-snapshot-showdown-go-nuts]Gleam.io[/url] and enter the raffle.
[*] The more points you collect, the better your chances of getting a big reward!
[*] Post your screenshot on Facebook, Twitter, or Instagram using the hashtags #Autumn, #RIFTGame, and #MMORPG. Then, verify your entry on [url=https://gleam.io/xmOzD/rift-autumn-snapshot-showdown-go-nuts]Gleam.io[/url].
[*] You’re good to go!
[/olist]

[b]Are there any rules?[/b]

Your screenshot must follow the autumn theme.
Some image editing is allowed; however, your entry must remain fully visible.
Inappropriate or offensive entries are strictly forbidden.

[b]What are the rewards?[/b]

Up to three (3) lucky Ascended will receive the adorable mount “[b]Wraps the Mummified Squirrel[/b]“! Winners will be contacted via email on December 5, 2023.

[url=https://forum.glyph.net/terms-of-participation-contest-en/]General Terms of Participation apply to all entries[/url].

What are you waiting for, Ascended? It’s time to go nuts or go home!

Cozy regards,
Your RIFT team.

notes.title: Dimension Contest: World Food Day!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/c0065ae8f4b73ee1ec02b56ab84a58d5dc95c4d2.jpg[/img]

Hello Ascended!
Today is World Food Day and we’re celebrating everything that is food and agriculture!

Wouldn’t it be nice to celebrate in RIFT as well with a fun challenge for a chance to get great rewards?
We agree! Starting today until November 13, 2023, create your ideal kitchen in your favorite dimension for a chance to earn a reward!

[b]How do I enter?[/b]

Entering the contest is simple! Check out the following steps:

[olist]
[*] Pick your favourite dimension (any dimension works!) and decorate it in the theme of the contest!
[*] Take a screenshot showcasing what you created and post it on the #[url=https://discord.gg/5kqjzAEnwf]world-food-day on Discord[/url] or on Facebook and X (formerly known as Twitter) using the #RIFTWorldFoodDay hashtag!
[*] Include your Character Name, Server and Region…
[*] …and you’re good to go!
[/olist]

[b]Are there any rules?[/b]

[olist]
[*] New creations are encouraged, but older ones are also ok.
[*] Content that is inappropriate or offensive is strictly forbidden.
[*] Image editing is allowed, however, your entry must remain visible.
[*] Entries that don’t include Character Name, Server and Region do not qualify to receive a reward and therefore are considered void.
[/olist]

[b]How do we determine winners and what are the rewards?[/b]

Winners are determined by creativity and being as close as possible to the theme of the contest!
Up to three (3) entries will receive 3000 Credits each!

Winners will be announced on November 20, 2023 on our website and social media platforms!

[i]Please note: Rewards may take up to two (2) weeks to be delivered.[/i]
[url=https://forum.glyph.net/terms-of-participation-contest-en/][b]General Terms of Participation apply[/b][/url].

We are ready, Ascended, show us your Dimension decoration skills!

Best regards,
Your RIFT team!

notes.title: RIFT Honors Steam’s 20th: Let’s Party!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/9e6d91e40f07b1aa1a7cf337be38c99ff05a4885.jpg[/img]

Hello Telarans,

[b]Happy Anniversary Steam![/b]

Today marks a significant milestone as we celebrate Steam’s 20th anniversary!
Steam has been a platform where players find new games & forge connections across various communities throughout the years, and we’re proud to count the inhabitants of Telara among them.

A big thank you is in order to our RIFT players from both Steam and Glyph platforms, your enduring support and dedication to RIFT over the years hasn’t gone unnoticed and we have prepared a few gifts for you to celebrate in style!

The celebrations won’t stop there either – October is just around the corner and soon we’ll be celebrating 10 wonderful years of RIFT on Steam! Stay tuned for more fun activities to come!

[b]Let’s Celebrate![/b]

From September 12, 2023, to September 26, 2023, every player who logs in will be granted 7 days of Patron for free, our optional subscription that offers numerous in-game perks, and an Arclight Rider, ready to take you anywhere on your Telaran adventures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/0e7bd6a34d5ca0cbc21c00114828ad25416ace5c.jpg[/img]

Additionally, all players will benefit from an XP boost, adding a little extra to your RIFT endeavors.

Last but not least, the following items will be available at a discount in the RIFT store!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/950270/RIFT__The_Rising_Storm_Power_Pack/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/623530/RIFT__Ascended_Essentials_Pack/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/310260/RIFT_Upgrade_Bundle_Pack/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/310240/RIFT_Classic_Collectors_Pack/

[b](In-game & Steam only)[/b] But that’s not all, all credit bundles are now available at a 50% discount!*

Credits allow you to obtain several useful items from the in-game store, such as the Level 65 Character Pack and several Greater and Trascended vials that grant amazing boosts, which also happen to be on discount, quite a treat isn’t it?

Be sure to catch the items you want to get, these deals will only be available from September 12, 2023 6PM UTC to September 19, 2023, 11AM UTC!

*[i]The in-game store is not showing the discount, however, the correct price will be deducted as written above.[/i]

[b]New or Returning to RIFT?[/b]

If you’re new to RIFT, or returning after a break, our community is here to support you!

Join the RIFT Discord and start engaging. And for a refresher or introduction, check out our [url=https://www.trionworlds.com/rift/en/?page_id=16715]new player guide[/url] that covers RIFT’s basics.

Now, login and celebrate with us 😊

Your RIFT Team

notes.title: Head to the Races for Budgie Days!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/c2f9cfc2a495bc26eb691ab290ce063e61475dae.png[/img]

Greetings, Ascended!

We hope all of you are friends with the feathered kind!
[b]It’s time for the return of the Budgies![/b]

Earn Chaos Motes by completing special daily quests! You can find the quest givers in Meridian, Sanctum, and Tempest Bay.

Some seasoned professionals may be out on that racetrack, so here are some tips to be just like them:

🐦 Stay within the marked path!
🐦 White checkpoints need to be hit throughout the race.
🐦 Make sure to make it to the green boosts first to receive Terminal Velocity to make your opponents eat your dust.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/1c3ab1a79982c957dbe3e44799ee14948631f1c4.png[/img]

We were waiting for a whole year! Now the time has finally come: The Summerfest is back! ⛱️

What is Summerfest? ☀️

You may be wondering about the origins of Summerfest. While some of the history is lost to time, many scholars believe that Summerfest dates back to ancient elven rituals involving burning sacrifices inside wicker figures. Of course, most elves would prefer to forget these barbaric references to their past. In fact, such practices are now forbidden by both High Elves and Kelari alike, although sometimes alluded to by disgruntled Dwarves. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/9bf79a9d38ebc68aac18702d45b7b454ba29c52b.gif[/img]

What remains in modern Telara is a celebration of flames for all Ascended to enjoy. Summerfest is now the holiday that marks the longest days of summer in Telara. Ascended continue to celebrate ancient traditions and have fun, even in the sweltering heat. This helps lighten the mood and distract celebrants from the stress of the near-constant threats against Telara.

Take part in our various Summerfest activities, starting on June 28, 2023, at 0:01 AM server time, and earn as much event currency as you can!

Hey Telarans on Steam!

Good news! We're making some updates to improve your gaming experience. Starting today, all Steam accounts need to be linked to a Glyph account to play Rift. New players will have their accounts linked automatically during the sign-up process.

By linking your Steam and Glyph accounts, you'll be able to claim your purchased DLCs and use vouchers without any technical issues. Plus, it'll give us the ability to provide better and more secure customer support.

If you need to unlink your accounts, our Customer Support team is here to help just like before. Please keep in mind, you can only unlink once a year.

Thanks for your understanding and happy gaming!

Your Rift team ✨

notes.title: Celebrate Summerfest 2022 with us!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/29d1b36c556ef429d8a9df4b35245b3c98a7d656.png[/img]

We were waiting for a whole year! Now the time has finally come: The Summerfest is back! ⛱️

[b]What is Summerfest?[/b] ☀️

You may be wondering about the origins of Summerfest. While some of the history is lost to time, many scholars believe that Summerfest dates back to ancient elven rituals involving burning sacrifices inside wicker figures. Of course, most elves would prefer to forget these barbaric references to their past. In fact, such practices are now forbidden by both High Elves and Kelari alike, although sometimes alluded to by disgruntled Dwarves. 

What remains in modern Telara is a celebration of flames for all Ascended to enjoy. Summerfest is now the holiday that marks the longest days of summer in Telara. Ascended continue to celebrate ancient traditions and have fun, even in the sweltering heat. This helps lighten the mood and distract celebrants from the stress of the near-constant threats against Telara.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/82abc4b48ef0bd5793f789947eec73fbfa1de888.gif[/img]

notes.title: Carnival of the Ascended 2021!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Ascended!

Celebrate with us the Carnival of the Ascended 2021, marking the 10th anniversary of the release of Rift. The World Event will start on March 25th and will last 4 weeks, until April 22nd, 2021 at 15.30.00 local server time.

The event will have three distinct phases that start on the following dates:
- [b]Phase 1[/b]: Thursday 25th of March
- [b]Phase 2[/b]: Thursday 15th of April at 15.30.00 local server time
- [b]Phase 3[/b]: Thursday 22nd of April at 15.30.00 local server time
- [b]End of the event[/b]: Thursday 29th of April at 15.30.00 local server time


What can you look forward to?


[b]New Artifact Sets[/b]

• Added three new Artifact sets. Collecting each one will be rewarded a Celebration Chest containing, among other items, 4 Auroral Doubloons!

Our Overlord
- Completing a 4-hour Carnival Minion Mission has a 50% chance to drop a Celebration Bag for Overlords that will grant a random artifact of this set.

Hero Generation
- Among the rewards for killing one of the Carnival IA bosses, players will receive a Celebration Bag for Adventurers that will grant a random artifact of this set.

Pinata Candy
- Hunt Pinatas across Telara for a 50% chance to drop a Celebration Bag for Pinata Hunters that will grant a random artifact of this set.

• Collect and complete all the three new artifact sets to earn the True Veteran achievement, which will give the "Elder" prefix title and 100 platinum.


[b]New Minion[/b]

• Uncover the story of the old Ascended Trillian Lockwert by acquiring its Minion Card
- Upon collecting it, a chain of 11 Minion Missions will be unlocked. Complete them all to acquire 5 new Minions, 4 collectible journal entries with Trillians story, and some additional Carnival of the Ascended currency!
- Get the full group to level 25 to unlock the "Long-lived" suffix Title through an achievement.


[b]Updated LootTables[/b]

• The Pinata Prize Bags obtained in Carnival IAs can now drop some of the pets added during the Carnival of the Ascended in 2020!


[b]New Items[/b]

• Support your faction! Obtain one of the Guardian Valmeras or the Defiant Warhorses with Auroral Doubloons or Credits to show your support and unlock an exclusive title through an achievement.

• Complement your faction looks with the Ascended Guardian or Defiant Wings. Or be a proud Telaran with the Tenth Anniversary Cape.

• The new Tenth Anniversary Cake will grant you a raid consumable granting 100 Endurance and it was modeled after the real Rift Release Cake that the studio made 10 years ago for the launch! Also available as a Dimensional item to sweeten your home.

• Ever wanted to trick others to be Unicorns and join your cavalry? The Fancy Celebration Cake can be placed for everyone to turn into Carnival Unicorns and ride along with you and will grant a special achievement with a vanity unlock: the Celebration Ruff!


[b]Fixes[/b]

• Store - Fixed an issue with older Carnival Dimensional items not appearing unless all class types were selected.

• Dimension - Floating Platform Device no longer duplicates itself visually when rotating the item in a dimension.

• Mystic Archer - Legendary Ride the Wind now reduces the cast time of Summoning Quiver as expected.

• Oracle - Prevented an exploit where Legendary Insignia of Blood could be triggered with non-damaging abilities.


What are you waiting for? Come and celebrate with us! Happy birthday, Rift!

notes.title: Call to Action: Budgie Madness
notes.notes:
Greetings, Ascended!

We hope all of you had a great start into 2021! In order to welcome you to this new year, the Budgies are back – with the Budgie Madness Call-to-Action Event!

Earn Chaos Motes by finishing special daily quests. The Questgivers can be found in Meridian, Sanctum and Tempest Bay.


Get your riding boots and prepare for the ride of your life! Join the Budgie Races and earn yourself your own feathery friend!
Some seasoned professionals may be out on that race track, so here are some tips to be the just like them:

[i]• Stay within the marked path!
• White checkpoints need to be hit throughout the race.
• Make sure to make it to the Green boosts first to receive Terminal Velocity to make your opponents eat your dust.
• Avoid Orange Traps, they’ll only slow you down![/i]

Stock up as many Chaos Motes as possible and trade them in for mounts and pets!

[b]Budgie Madness will start on Friday, January 8, at 12am Server Time, and end on Sunday, January 10, at 11:59pm Server Time.[/b]

[b]Fae Yule 2020[/b]

The event will have three distinct phases that start on the following dates:
- [b]Phase 1[/b]: Thursday 10th of December at 15.30.00 local server time
- [b]Phase 2[/b]: Thursday 17th of December at 15.30.00 local server time
- [b]Phase 3[/b]: Thursday 24th of December at 15.30.00 local server time

- [b]Start[/b]: Thursday 10th of December at 08.05.00 local server time
- [b]End[/b]: Thursday 14th of January at 08.00.00 local server time


[b]Adjustments[/b]
The price of previous year's pets and minions has been lowered permanently.


[b]New Essences[/b]
Push the limits of your essences with the new Seraphic Zephyr and Seraphic Torrent Unique essences, with a focus on each of the main stats.
Shadowpriest (WIS), Shadowcaller (INT), Shade Stalker (DEX), and Death Knight (STR) versions are available.

The Fae whisper about the evil alchemist that lurks in the dark hunting those boglings that have misbehaved this year. Remind them about their folk tales with the Nebulous Omen Cape or the Infinity Flask vanity items.

Remember to stay warm though, or you will end up looking like our new Icy Levitation, a special levitation that makes you frosty!

The forecast from the Icewatch was correct. This winter is going to be one of the coldest in Telara, and the patrols are starting to find out all kinds of frozen creatures.

notes.title: Let's Celebrate 20 Years of gamigo!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/a10cb671e9909236af7f6535291233af9aa29449.jpg[/img]

gamigo is turning 20 years old! 20 years of memories, ups and downs, friendships, soulmates, enemies and kinship. We would like to share our happiness with you all in the form of events, challenges, social media and forum activities, and much more! There will be tons of chances to win some amazing prizes, such as gaming devices, hoodies and thousands of Euros of in-game currencies across our dozens of games!

Since this is the perfect opportunity to show you all how much you mean to us, we will also have a very special tiered reward system with special bundles. Every time we hit a goal you will be rewarded for your favorite games. Our communities make us the amazing gaming company we are today, we never could have done any of it without you! You all make this a gaming family; you are the heart and soul of this 20th anniversary celebration. Thank you!


[u][b]All that is happening:[/b][/u]

[i][u]Anniversary Points – Win cool stuff![/u][/i]
You can win Anniversary points in weekly challenges and screen shots event and via voucher codes!

[i][u]Challenges[/u][/i]
Compete in server challenges and be the best of your game to win anniversary points. The first one has already started, check it out [url=http://forums.riftgame.com/rift-administration-staff/rift-administrators/513041-20-years-gamigo-first-challenge.html]here[/url]!

[u][i]Screen Shots[/i][/u]
Mimic the posted screen shot and win anniversary points. The first one has already started, check it out [url=http://forums.riftgame.com/rift-administration-staff/rift-administrators/513033-screenshot-challenge-recipe-1-perfect-place.html]here[/url]!

[u][i]Vouchers[/i][/u]
Watch in-game, social media pages, Discord chats, and forums for surprise vouchers codes. There is no rhyme nor reason to when or where they will pop-up. They will only pop-up in one location at a time, so keep your eyes peeled for them. The first 10 players to redeem the voucher will earn 500 Anniversary Points, the small gift is yours to keep of course! Be quick and don’t miss out.

[u][i]What can I win?[/i][/u]
Gather the most anniversary points to rank in the leaderboard for your game. If you manage to stay on the leaderboard by the time the event is fully finished, you will receive a cool prize and be entered into a raffle for a Mouse and Keyboard bundle as well as game cash for your game.

Want to keep an eye on your points? Then [url=https://20anniversary.gamigo.com/]watch [/url]the Leaderboard!

[u][i]Special Bundles with a kick![/i][/u]
Special Shop Bundles have been created and each purchase helps progress the bar towards a goal to earn cool prizes or events that can be received and enjoyed by everyone!

Check out the Bundles in game!

Special bundle purchases from all games will help move the bar.


These are the fun things you can unlock:

[b]Level 1[/b]
2 Greater Experience Vials
2 Great Favor Vials

[b]Level 2[/b]
3 Dark Levitation Supply Crate

[b]Level 3[/b]
1 Cache of Individual Reward Charges
5 Tenebrean Planar Attuner

[b]Level 4[/b]
1 Fabulous Moosedantix


View the progress of the bundle tiers anytime on the [url=https://20anniversary.gamigo.com/]Anniversary Website[/url]!

[u][i]Share your moments[/i][/u]
Share with us your most memorable moment from any gamigo game for the past 20 years
OR
Wish us a happy birthday!


Wanna know how, check out the [url=https://20th.gamigo.net/en/shareyourmoment.html]website[/url]!


[u][b]Important Information:[/b][/u]

[i][u]Winners[/u][/i]
Winners will be published at the end of the month when all events have ended, and everything tallied. We appreciate your patience and understanding while we take the time to ensure everything is counted properly before we announce the winner.

[u][i]Anniversary Point Ranking and Bundle Progression[/i][/u]
The Anniversary Point rankings and Special Bundle progression bar will not be auto updated, they will be updated once per normal workday to reflect the goings on from the past hours. We do not have an exact time this will happen, nor do we guarantee it will happen over the weekend. Only the top 50 users on the rankings will be visible, and rankings will be split per game. All point totals for all users, even those not in the top 50, will still be saved.

[u][i]Rankings[/i][/u]
Names in the rankings will be displayed with asterisks blocking all except the first and last letter of the ranked party’s name (for example O****N instead of ORION). By using the voucher item, you will be agreeing to have your full character name available to everyone who views the page: [b]SHOWYOURNAME20RIFT[/b]
The name that will be displayed in the ranking, will be the name of the first character you login on you account, after redeeming the  SHOWYOURNAME20RIFT voucher.

Visit our [url=https://support.gamigo.com/hc/en/articles/360054828194-20-gamigo-Jubil%C3%A4um]FAQ[/url] for more information!

2. Employees of gamigo AG or their relatives, and Game Masters or their relatives are not allowed to participate.
3. Participants will be entered to win the prizes mentioned in the event description.
4. If gamigo has reasonable suspicion of the violation of these rules, then gamigo reserves the possibility to exclude those persons from participating. In those cases, it’s possible to revoke prizes afterwards and draw a new winner.
5. The prize cannot be transferred to another person and cannot be paid as cash. gamigo reserves the right to replace single prizes with equivalent or superior prizes. It’s not possible to give prizes to underage persons.
6. If there are disagreements regarding the rules, the process or results of the raffle, then the decision made by gamigo is final. It is not subject to legal recourse.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/6548ada311fb1401d77873ea9eabe51912497d24.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Ascended!

The early bird catches the worm! So don't wait any longer because it is time for "[b]Budgie Madness[/b]" again!

Earn [b]Chaos Motes[/b] by finishing special daily quests! The Questgivers can be found in Meridian, Sanctum and Tempest Bay.


Get your riding boots and prepare for the ride of your life! Join the Budgie Races and earn yourself your own feathery friend!
Some seasoned professionals may be out on that race track, so here are some tips to be the just like them:

• Stay within the marked path!
• White checkpoints need to be hit throughout the race.
• Make sure to make it to the Green boosts first to receive Terminal Velocity to make your opponents eat your dust.
• Avoid Orange Traps, they’ll only slow you down!

Stock up as many Chaos Motes as possible and trade them in for mounts and pets!


Budgie Madness will start on [b]Friday, August 21, at 12am Server Time, and end on Sunday, August 23, at 11:59pm Server Time[/b].


What are you waiting for? Tell your friends, join us in Rift and grab those Budgies!

notes.title: Battle Pass Season 4: Vein of Glory
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/887a3384725b05cd215a9475ba8d429d123b5827.png[/img]

Greetings, Ascended!

Prepare your weapons and ready yourselves; the fourth season of Battle Pass is now live!

The fourth season will be live from [b]June 18, 2020 at 4:30pm server time[/b], until [b]August 13, 2020 at 4:30pm server time[/b].

What can you look forward to? Here is an overview of the new [b]Battle Pass season - Vein of Glory[/b]:


[u][b]NEW[/b][/u]

[b]Daily Quests:[/b]


• Players will now receive the following quests every 24h:
1x 'Random Dungeon Victory': Complete a random Expert Dungeon
1x 'Random Warfront Victory': Win a random warfront
2x Random Daily Quests (+2x dailies for Patron subscribers)

• Rerolling daily quests will not grant either the 'Random Dungeon Victory' or the 'Random Warfront Victory' quests.


[b]Weekly Quests:[/b]

• Players will now receive the following quests every 7 days:
1x 'Anomaly Tamer': Complete 20 Battle Pass quests
2x Random Weekly Quests

• Rerolling weekly quests will not grant the 'Anomaly Tamer' quest.

• All weekly quests grant a base Battle Pass EXP of 10K.


[b]Battle Pass EXP:[/b]

• When completing a Battle Pass quest, players receive a Concentrated Expertise Cache on their inventory, that will grant Loyalty points and Battle Pass EXP based on their status.

• Players who own the Battle Pass obtain +25% Battle Pass EXP for the quest completed.

• Active Patron subscribers obtain +25% Battle Pass EXP for the quest completed.

• Players who own the Battle Pass and have an active Patron subscription obtain +50% Battle Pass EXP for the quest completed.

• Purchasing the Battle Pass or activating a Patron subscription will NOT grant extra EXP over already completed quests.


[u][b]IMPROVEMENTS & FIXES[/b][/u]


• Quest EXP gain overhaul. Adjusted EXP gained from several daily quests. All weekly quests grant 10K Battle Pass EXP (Half a level).

• Fixed an issue where quests to hunt rare mobs were only counting the zone achievement rares.

• Rare mobs that count towards a specific zone quest are now displayed on the tooltip upon hover-over.

• Removed several quests that were complicated to trigger when there were not enough players in the required zone.

• Added new quests to close rifts across the continents in Telara! (Mathosia, Dusken & Brevane)

• An additional cosmetic item "Crown of the Earth Baron" will be available in the Rift Store.

• Players are now able to buy Concentrated Expertise shards in the Rift Store to level up immediately. Available in +1 and +5 level format.

• The new Dimension Kit: Imperial Mining Expedition contains unreleased dimensional items, including the new scaffolding building modules.

• Improved Battle Pass localization.


[u][b]REMINDER[/b][/u]

• After the Battle Pass Season is over, players will have 7 days to claim all pending rewards. During this time, players can acquire the Battle Pass and claim all regular tier
rewards.

notes.title: RIFT Team Letter - November 8, 2018
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/cdae3a32db79db58e73c5a9157be844c1f8d4eff.jpg[/img]

Greetings Ascended,

We appreciate your patience as we take some time to solidify plans moving forward. There are a ton of moving parts involved in the transition from where we were to where we want to go, and it’s going to take us a bit of time to navigate all of the changes required to keep Telara and its denizens happy with the world we’ve called home for so long.

With our smaller team we’re still working out the details on what future content updates will look like. While plans are being made for the future, we’re going to be focusing the team on implementing Quality of Life improvements for RIFT in the short term.

We can’t share specifics yet because there's still work being done behind the scenes to build a strong foundation for the future. It’s on this foundation that all future updates will be built. This includes examining the health of our shard populations and looking at ways to make sure all of our players have the best possible experience in game.

If you have specific feedback on the kinds of quality of life changes you’d like to see, be sure to share them with us! It would be very helpful to get a sense for what you feel are your main pain points.

We just wanted to take another moment to thank you for your patience as we’ve been working behind the scenes to get things stabilized. More news will be coming down the road so please bear with us a while longer.

-The RIFT Team

notes.title: Autumn Harvest: Extended

Update - Autumn Harvest is being extended an extra week and will now run through November 14, 2018!

Cool breezes and brightly colored leaves usher in Autumn Harvest starting today, October 18th! Wings, heads and tails. [b]Tails?[/b] YES, we've introduced our very first tail item in RIFT!

Take a half dozen toxic spores from the Xarth Mire, mix in some devious beasties, swirl them together with toxic miasma and just like that, we're ready for the season of spirits!

Claim Lady Glasya's wings in the RIFT Store on Live or Prime! These pinions are loaded with dark power, and are served up in both cosmetic and mount versions in the pack, offering you flexibility in your pairings! [b]This just in: you may also choose Lady Glasya's TAIL from the pack, the very first tail item ever offered in RIFT![/b]

Noxious Levitation will leave a cloud of poisonous ruin in your wake as you travel across Telara. They will be offered for Credits on Live and a consumable version for event currency on Prime.

We'll have more images of the terrific new items next week and will feature them on the October 19th Livestream, where Autumn Harvest and Extra-Life share the stage! notes.title: Rise of the Phoenix
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/8ec6bbabaeba8f5791b6183f609fe55ef24bdfff.jpg[/img]

Summer is almost over but things are really heating up on RIFT Prime!

This week brings new RIFT Prime content for Ascended to enjoy! This week’s game update includes a brand-new Tier 2 raid shard, Tier 2 of Planar Attunement, and a new story quest line! Learn more about each in each of the sections below.

[B]New Raid Shard[/B]

[I]Rise of the Phoenix[/I]

This level 50 10-man raid takes place in an alternate Telaran timeline. When High Priest Arakhurn opened the Planar Gate in this timeline, instead of opening a portal to the Earth Plane, it accidentally opens into the Plane of Fire. In this raid, Arakhurn’s acolytes absorb the flames and the High Priest himself is turned into a phoenix! To get there, Ascended must have either Omen Sight or Quantum Sight to see the portal in West Stonefield. But be careful, it’s sure to get hot!

[I]Advance to Planar Attunement Tier 2[/I]

Planar Attunement is relatively new to RIFT Prime. To learn more about it, check out our [URL=https://www.trionworlds.com/rift/en/2018/07/11/the-next-big-prime-update-is-here-introducing-4-5/]Planar Attunement announcement blog[/URL] from July 11th. Now, with this week’s game update, worthy Ascended can advance all the way to the second tier and become even more powerful!

[I]New Quest Line: Saga of the Wanton Maw[/I]

Originally released with RIFT’s 1.8 patch, the Saga of the Wanton Maw comes to Prime! This cult saga questline is for Prime Ascended who’ve attained level 50. The wicked followers of Maelforge are up to no good and they must be stopped! The story also leads Ascended into the upcoming Infernal Dawn Raid.

For the complete list of updates for this week’s game update, check out the [URL=http://forums.riftgame.com/rift-prime-vigil-discussion-reading-anyone-posting-patron-only/prime-vigil-patch-notes/506269-rift-4-5-hotfix-8-8-15-2018-a.html?_ga=2.99090008.719803762.1534180793-135744424.1527788068]official Prime patch notes here[/URL]. Heralding the prelude to one of RIFT’s most memorable expansions, Spoils of War returns in 2018. This time, it will appear on RIFT Prime.

[B]Spoils of War[/B]

The Ascended mourned the dead in [URL=https://www.trionworlds.com/rift/en/2018/07/11/grim-remembrance]Grim Remembrance[/URL], set Telara ablaze in [URL=https://www.trionworlds.com/rift/en/2018/07/10/summerfest-2018]Summerfest[/URL], and saved the fate of all of Telara in the [URL=https://www.trionworlds.com/rift/en/2018/07/25/introducing-river-of-souls-for-rift-prime]River of Souls[/URL]. With the defeat of Alsbeth, the Ascended can take a break and enjoy their hard-fought victory. Fate seems to be with them, as caches of coin have suddenly appeared around the main cities, and shells of golden dragon eggs have begun to appear in earth and fire rifts. Is this just the Ascended's reward? Or is there some sinister purpose behind this abundance of gold?

If you missed out on participating in the event before, here’s your second chance! Or, experience it again on RIFT Prime. Spoils of War returns on [B]Thursday, August 16, 2018[/B]. Have something to say? Discuss the event here!

notes.title: Defiance 2050 Invades RIFT Aug 2 – Aug 6
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/7144a355d9ec622e5865a1b64eecf65508e9be17.jpg[/img]

Hellbugs have invaded Telara! Get in there and save the world, Ascended!

Prevent these Hellbugs from their aggressive colonization of Telara. These suspiciously familiar invaders have jumped from the other worldly city of San Francisco to Telara to try and make it their home. Don’t let them gain a foothold as they spread from one end of Mathosia to the other.

[B]Call-to-Action Event[/B]

From Thursday, August 2, 2018 beginning at 12:01 AM PDT until Monday, August 6, 2018 at 11:59 PM PDT, Hellbugs from Defiance 2050 will invade RIFT! During this limited-time event, Hellbug Rifts will spawn more frequently throughout Telara (on both Live and Prime). Additionally, new zones have been added to their rampage, including Scarwood Reach, Shimmersand, Iron Pine Peak, and Ember Isle.

Participating in this Call to Action event can net you some unique prizes. Completing these Hellbug Rifts have a chance to award you:
[LIST]
[*] Minor XP or Token Boosts (15%)
[*] Bonus Currency
[*] Special Dimension Items
[*] Minions (Live only)
[*] Wardrobe Skin Items & Bundles
[*] Special Mounts (including three not previously released on Live)
[/LIST]
Note that on Live, zone events use personal loot IRCs. Players get two free rolls per zone per day, after that, they are charged. Prime however, has no gating on rolls.

[B]Hellbug Sale[/B]

Besides the event itself, the RIFT store will have special Hellbugs you can purchase as well. The sale runs from Wednesday, August 1, 2018 after the servers come up (approximately 9:00 AM PDT) until Wednesday, August 15, 2018 until the servers go down for maintenance (approximately 6:00 AM PDT).
[LIST]
[*] Hellbug Mounts
[*] Hellbug Combat Pet Skin Bundle
[*] Unique Pet – Tartarus
[*] Votan Fragger Rifle Wardrobe Skin
[*] New Dimension Items including Hellbug NPCs
[/LIST]
These Hellbug goodies are largely available for either Credits or the new in-game Chaos Mote currency. However, a few are Credit-only.

We here at Trion Worlds, Inc. are excited for Defiance 2050. The RIFT team welcomes the new game into our fold with this new Hellbug-themed event! Also, be on the lookout for upcoming new Call-to-Action events, to spice up your time in Telara. We hope to see you in-game, Ascended!

notes.title: Introducing River of Souls for RIFT Prime
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/03ddeef328a749af9ec83c34b26325acdc07fd7d.jpg[/img]

Alsbeth has been scheming up something wicked. Ascended, you must stop her!

We are excited to introduce a new raid for RIFT Prime players to fight their way through. Introducing River of Souls! This classic, level 50 20-man raid continues the story on Prime and what was hinted at in our Grim Remembrance event.

[B]The Soulstream[/B]

When Telaran’s or Planetouched die, their spirits are whisked away to the Soulstream. This place is a river of intertwining souls that drift along the border of the Plane of Death.

From the edge of the Plane of Death, Alsbeth the Discordant, has control of a device that grants her access to the Soulstream. She is now able to draw forth any soul she likes, returning the poor subject to Telara as a Deathtouched minion of Regulos. If the Endless Court keeps hold of the Soulstream, death will offer no rest to the peoples of Telara, and neither gods nor machines will have souls to draw upon for Ascension.

Besides having to worry about Alsbeth, legions of walking nightmares patrol the perimeter of the Soulstream. They are waiting to descend upon Telara. Alsbeth plucked two powerful souls from this bunch to protect her while she fishes for the most valuable souls in the river. The Ascended will have to fight their way through these undead minions, including foes they’ve faced before, and REgulos’ herald Gaurath.

All of Alsbeth’s schemes and betrayals have led to the River of Souls, and she will fight with every resource available to achieve her horrid goals of damning all of Telara.

 

Get out there and defeat Alsbeth once and for all! Do not let her corrupt the souls of the dead and bring about the end of Telara. It is time to prepare your friends and enter the River of Souls!

notes.title: The Next Big Prime Update is Here! Introducing 4.5!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/48a87a5388780be03d1dfc4df50a945cef9066e3.jpg[/img]

It’s Prime time to play RIFT Prime, now that our next big update, 4.5 is here!

Beginning July 11, 2018, RIFT Prime is updated to 4.5, which includes tons of new content like quests, onslaughts, new gear, planar attunement, class balance updates, and much, much more!

[h1]Ember Isle[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/539b8590eb38e4f74fb912436fb279f8125cc154.jpg[/img]

The long awaited Ember Isle is ready to explore on Prime. Considered by many to be one of RIFT’s most beautiful zones, this lush tropical paradise is home to the Farclan Dwarves and the Kelari who battle for the resources of the island. And in the center the menacing presence to Mount Cacera an active volcano, what secrets lie in its heart.
[list]
 	[*]Over 30 new quests[/*]
 	[*]More than a dozen new Rifts[/*]
 	[*]Over 20 more achievements[/*]
 	[*]More than 15 new rare creatures to track down[/*]
 	[*]More zone events[/*]
 	[*]Even a new zone puzzle - all the things you expect from a full-featured RIFT zone[/*]
[/list]
[h1]Introducing Onslaughts for Prime[/h1]

When the fissures known as the Sourcewells first appeared, it was quickly realized that these founts of energy were like a bountiful feed trough for the planar invaders on the island. Many Kelari found themselves called to take up the mantle of the five heroes and guard the Sourcewells. They built the defenses and, to this day, remain at their posts, giving their very lives to deny this food to the enemy.
[list]
 	[*]Take a defensive position and get ready for battle[/*]
 	[*]Upgrade the Lifesprings and Turrets to give yourself the best chance of survival[/*]
 	[*]Improve your power against the plains by upgrading the Dense Arch at the center of each Sourcewell[/*]
 	[*]Earn the respect of the Keepers and gain access to their merchants[/*]
[/list]
[h1]New Treasures in Caduceus Rise[/h1]

Caduceus, a powerful Telaran Sprit, has been corrupted by energy from the Plane of Earth. The Kelari built a temple at Caduceus Rise to honor this sprit where they would offer him gifts in exchange for boons. This was long ago in the past. Today, the Golden Maw and some of their Wanton allies occupy the temple. They have been haggling with Caduceus.

Meanwhile Laethys has been transported through The Plan of Fire to Ember Isle in the form of golden treasure from the hardened liquid gold in Chalmers Caldera. Her spirit was torn in the journey, and fragments of her soul became bound to objects of wealth scattered about Ember Isle.

The Golden Maw formed an agreement with Caduceus for the spirit to use its powerful Earth magic to help reform Laethys a corporal dragon. Will the Ascended be able to stop this diabolical plan before it’s too late?
[list]
 	[*]The Golden Maw and some of their Wanton allies occupy the temple at Caduceus Rise, built by the Kelari to honor the powerful Telaran spirit, Caduceus.[/*]
 	[*]In their ongoing efforts to give Laethys a corporeal form, her cult followers have made an agreement with Caduceus to lend his powerful Earth magic to their cause.[/*]
 	[*]By negating Caduceus' assistance, the Ascended buy more time against Laethys' attempts to return to full strength on Telara.[/*]
 	[*]Both Expert Caduceus Rise and Expert Upper Caduceus Rise will be available.[/*]
[/list]
[h1]Planar Attunement Now on Prime[/h1]

Worthy Guardians are granted these powers through a ritual with the Messenger of the Vigil and the great piece of sourcestone in the heart of Sanctum. The Ascended is said to have been brought closer to The Vigil and thus able to interact with planar energies in a manner more akin to that of the Vigil.

For the Defiants, a new machine was constructed by Sylver Valis that would attune them to The Planes more closely. Defiant Ascended were returned in bodies made of sourcestone. Sylver's machine attunes this sourcestone to the planes from which it was created.
[list]
 	[*]Planar Attunements provide base enhancements to your character's Calling from each Plane, and is not Soul-specific.[/*]
 	[*]Your experience bar will turn into a Planar Attunement meter when you reach level 50. The mouseover tooltip will indicate that you are earning experience toward Planar Attunement.[/*]
 	[*]You must purchase all Planar Attunement abilities of a given tier before you can begin spending points in the next tier up. More tiers will be unlocked in future updates.[/*]
 	[*]Rested experience does not apply to post-level-50 Planar Attunement experience.[/*]
[/list]

To learn more about all the changes in the 4.5 update, check out the [url=http://forums.riftgame.com/rift-prime-vigil-discussion-reading-anyone-posting-patron-only/prime-vigil-patch-notes/505587-rift-4-5-update-7-11-2018-a.html]patch notes for Prime here[/url]. Then, don’t forget to give us feedback on this update in ththis thread. If you’ve left Prime, now is the perfect time to return and enjoy all this new content.

notes.title: Grim Remembrance
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/03ddeef328a749af9ec83c34b26325acdc07fd7d.jpg[/img]

Alsbeth has waited far too long for the River of Souls to open in Telara. Find out what secrets she has planned…

From Wednesday, July 11, 2018 at 8:30 AM PDT until Wednesday, July 25, 2018 at 8:00 AM PDT, participate in a long-anticipated series of zone events in Silverwood, Freemarch, Gloamwood, Stonefield, Stillmoor, and Shimmersand, along with some daily quests. Take part in the event to earn in-game rewards such as cosmetics, trinkets, and (Prime-only) gear. This is the prelude to the River of Souls raid, coming soon to RIFT Prime!

[h1]What is The Grim Remembrance?[/h1]

The Grim Remembrance is when the Ascended mark the first of the recent apocalypses that have beset our world, when a mad cult leader would have succeeded in destroying all that exists on behalf of the Blood Storm, but for the timely intercession of a raid of Ascended who stopped their plans. Things may be a little colder than the usual weather in Summerfest, a bit gloomier. It's not as joyful as Fae Yule, but the Ascended always mark the moment upon the parapets of Caer Mathos when time stood still, and the world was saved.

This event will take place on both RIFT Live and Prime. For RIFT Prime, this will be the event leading up to the River of Souls raid unlock. For players on RIFT Live, this will be a chance to take part in a reimagined take on the original event.

[h1]Who is Alsbeth the Discordant?[/h1]

Alsbeth the Discordant was the first of the cult leaders to reveal herself since the Ascended appeared on Telara. In life, she had always sought power, be it befriending Asha Catari, the most powerful mage of her class at Quicksilver College, by moving up the social ladder in the court of King Jostir, or by choosing the side she thought she would have the most to gain from when rebellion broke out against Aedraxis. But it was only in death when her true destructive nature imperiled all of Telara. While the heroes of Telara were brought back to life as Guardians of the Vigil, or traveled back in time as the Defiant heralds of the end times, Alsbeth had returned in secret as the handmaid of Regulos, the Destroyer.

She had played her part well at first, pretending that her ascension was just like all the other miracles of the gods or science, when in truth she was returned to the World of Telara as part of an unholy deal with the dragon of death to bring an end to all things. But the Ascended do not suffer villains lightly, and time after time her plans were thwarted. From the conquest of Freemarch to the corruption of Gloamwood, the Ascended stopped her schemes and spells at every turn. Even her supply chain of sourcestone from Scarlet Gorge was shut down. If she was to make good upon the many promises she made to that unforgiving dragon, she would have to conquer the Ascended and destroy the world in one fell swoop. By unleashing the dead upon Telara, its former heroes and villains, monsters and protectors, she hoped she would cause time to stand still and in the confusion strike a blow against the Ascended that would break the ward and bring her master Regulos back from destruction and into an everlasting night of the Plane of Death.

If you missed out before, this is your chance to experience the reimagined Grim Remembrance! If you’re a new player on Prime, join this exciting event to find out what’s to come on Prime. Have something to say? Post it here!
