[B]What treasures are waiting to be claimed in Caduceus Rise?[/B]
Caduceus, a powerful Telaran Sprit has been corrupted by energy from the Plane of Earth. The Kelari built a temple at Caduceus Rise to honor this sprit where they would offer him gifts in exchange for boons. This was long ago in the past. Today the Golden Maw as well as some of their Wanton allies occupy the temple. They have been haggling with Caduceus.

Meanwhile Laethys has been transported through The Plan of Fire to Ember Isle in the form of golden treasure from the hardened liquid gold in Chalmers Caldera. Her spirit was torn in the journey, and fragments of her soul became bound to objects of wealth scattered about Ember Isle. 

The Golden Maw formed an agreement with Caduceus for the spirit to use its powerful Earth magic to help reform Laethys a corporal dragon. Will the Ascended be able to stop this diabolical plan before it’s too late?
[LIST]
[*] The Golden Maw and some of their Wanton allies occupy the temple at Caduceus Rise, built by the Kelari to honor the powerful Telaran spirit, Caduceus.
[*] In their ongoing efforts to give Laethys a corporeal form, her cult followers have made an agreement with Caduceus to lend his powerful Earth magic to their cause.
[*] By negating Caduceus' assistance, the Ascended buy more time against Laethys' attempts to return to full strength on Telara.
[*] Both Expert Caduceus Rise and Expert Upper Caduceus Rise will be available.
[/LIST]
[B]Planar Attunement will make more power and abilities available to players.[/B]
Worthy Guardians are granted these powers through a ritual with the Messenger of the Vigil and the great piece of sourcestone in the heart of Sanctum. The Ascended is said to have been brought closer to The Vigil and thus able to interact with planar energies in a manner more akin to that of the Vigil.

For the Defiants, a new machine was constructed by Sylver Valis that would attune them to The Planes more closely. Defiant Ascended were returned in bodies made of sourcestone. Sylver's machine attunes this sourcestone to the planes from which it was created.
[LIST]
[*] Planar Attunements provide base enhancements to your character's Calling from each Plane, and is not Soul-specific.
[*] Your experience bar will turn into a Planar Attunement meter when you reach level 50. The mouseover tooltip will indicate that you are earning experience toward Planar Attunement.
[*] You must purchase all Planar Attunement abilities of a given tier before you can begin spending points in the next tier up.
[*] Rested experience does not apply to post-level-50 Planar Attunement experience.
[/LIST]
[B]BANK[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Fixed a bug that would not allow you to move items directly from your shard vault to your bank.
[/LIST]
[B]CALLINGS[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue causing many procs to incorrectly proc other procs. This has been a long-standing issue and may result in some abilities or procs no longer interacting with other buffs and effects as they have previously. We’ll continue to monitor abilities for any unintended side effects. If you believe you’ve found one, please let us know on the forums!
[*] Cleric
[LIST]
[*] Purifier
[LIST]
[*] Flame of Life – Adjusted stacking priority for Flame of Life and Legendary Flame of Life to correctly reflect the damage reduction provided by the ability.
[*] Legendary Flash of the Phoenix now has its cooldown reduced to 30s, and no longer triggers the shared combat rez cooldown, if cast on a living ally.
[/LIST]
[*] Runeshaper
[LIST]
[*] Bonus Rune of Smiting damage from Legendary Seal of Vulnerability can now only be triggered by the Seal’s original caster. 
[*] Fixed an issue where Rune of Travail, with the Powered Inscription talent, could occasionally refresh a normal Seal of Vulnerability with the legendary version. 
[*] Fixed another issue where Rune of Travail, with the Powered Inscription talent, would refresh Seal of Pain with Seal of Vulnerability instead. 
[*] Fixed a minor issue where an extra debuff effect would appear on the target momentarily when Seal of Enhancement was cast.
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[*] Mage
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue with Eldritch Armor where Bloom would consume the reactive buff.
[*] Chloromancer
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue preventing the cast time reduction from Harbinger’s Eldritch Armor proc from affecting Bloom or Flourish if less than 2 points have been spent in Healing Slipstream.
[/LIST]
[*] Harbinger
[LIST]
[*] Tempest Winds no longer requires a Blade buff.
[*] Updated Lightning Charge to provide the same damage proc from Slashing attacks as Lightning Blade.
[*] New Ability: Luminous Blessing – This is a copy of the Luminous Weapon ability, but does not transform the caster’s weapon. It is gained at the same time you gain Luminous Weapon.
[*] New Ability: Reaper’s Essence – This is a copy of the Reaper’s Blade ability, but does not transform the caster’s weapon. It is gained when you gain Reaper’s Blade. There is also a Legendary version of this ability that is gained whenever Legendary Reaper’s Blade is selected.
[*] Legendary Reaper’s Blade and Legendary Reaper’s Essence now grant their damage bonus for the full duration of the buff instead of as a proc when an enemy dies.
[/LIST]
[*] Mystic Archer
[LIST]
[*] The wardrobe appearance “Crumbling Ivory Magus Bow” is now unlocked for any account that has purchased the Mystic Archer class.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing Arcane Summoning from working correctly when multiple Mages with the talent are attacking the same target. This talent should now work independently for each Mage.
[/LIST]
[*] Necromancer
[LIST]
[*] Legendary Reaper’s Touch – This now causes the Mage’s pet’s damaging abilities to apply 2 additional stacks of Deathly Calling while Reaper’s Touch is active.
[*] Fixed an issue where if the enemy had more than 5 stacks of Deathly Calling, Desecrate would only deal damage as though there were 5 stacks and then remove all Deathly Calling stacks. Desecrate will now deal damage correctly based on the number of stacks of Deathly Calling on the enemy.
[*] Removed Legendary Grave Rot.
[*] Added Legendary Desecrate – Deals Death damage based on the number of stacks of Deathly Calling on the enemy. Curses the enemy for 20s, increasing damage taken from the Mage’s pet by 5% per stack of Deathly Calling on the enemy when Desecrate is cast.
[*] Due to the removal of Legendary Grave Rot, all builds using the Necromancer soul have had their talent points refunded.
[*] Fixed an issue that would prevent Lich Form from being cast.
[*] Fixed an issue when a Mage has both Legendary Condemn and Legendary Reaper’s Touch, Deathly Calling would not stack higher than 5 while Legendary Reaper’s Touch was active.
[*] Increased the duration of Legendary Reaper’s Touch to 16s. Increased damage of both the damage over time portion and the damage burst at the end.
[*] Putrify now causes the Necromancer pet to apply the maximum number of stacks of Deathly Calling to the enemy. (i.e. It will now apply 10 stacks if you have Legendary Condemn).
[*] Legendary Condemn now also increases the Mage’s damage to the enemy by 1% per stack.
[/LIST]
[*] Pyromancer
[LIST]
[*] Updated the talent description for Pyromancer’s Vengeance to accurately reflect how the talent functions. It now indicates it increases the proc chance of Pyromancer’s Blessing by 2/4% per stack instead of 1 / 2% per stack. This is only a change to the tooltip and does not affect talent or ability functionality.
[/LIST]
[*] Stormcaller
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue where Wind Chill would consume a stack from Pyromancer’s Internalize Charge.
[/LIST]
[*] Warlock
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue preventing multiple Mages from having Lingering Torment, from Legendary Neddra’s Grasp, active on an enemy at the same time.
[*] Legendary Life Leech – Updated the ability description to indicate the percent chance for non-warlock abilities to refresh Life Leech.
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[*] Rogue
[LIST]
[*] Bard
[LIST]
[*] The Oracle buff Inspiration of Survival is no longer able to overwrite Motif of Regeneration.
[/LIST]
[*] Marksman
[LIST]
[*] Fixed several issues with Legendary Rapid Fire Shot. Fixed an issue allowing each use of Legendary Rapid Fire Shot on the same target to provide a multiplicative bonus to all subsequent casts of Legendary Rapid Fire Shot from other Rogues for the duration of the attack. Fixed an issue with damage interval timing.
[*] Updated Legendary Rapid Fire Shot to deal damage more closely matching numbers in the ability description.
[/LIST]
[*] Saboteur
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue where Detonate would cause Scatter Sticky Bomb to deal damage twice as many times as they should.
[*] Fixed an issue where Scatter Sticky Bomb would not correctly count Fragmentation Sticky Bomb when determining how many times it should explode when Detonate is used.
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[*] Warrior
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue where the warrior’s energy bar would bounce between 0 and 20 several times when the energy regen buff from their eternal weapon was applied.
[*] Due to addition/removal of legendary abilities from Champion and Warlord, any build utilizing these souls have been reset.
[*] Beastmaster
[LIST]
[*] Legendary Vicious Opportunity – No longer removes damage over time effects on use. Reduced bonus damage per damage over time effect by 15%. Now must follow a critical hit by the Beastmaster’s pet.
[/LIST]
[*] Champion
[LIST]
[*] Grim Satisfaction – Removed the internal cooldown on the proc.
[*] Mired – Increase damage bonus to 4/8/12%. Up from 3/6/9%.
[*] Updated Legendary Punishing Blow - Deals Physical damage per Attack Point. Increases the damage of area of effect abilities, equal to double the number of Attack Points used, by 35%. Lasts 30s
[*] Updated Legendary Dominating Bearing – Grants all Bearings. Increases damage done by 10%. Damaging single target abilities apply Domination to the enemy, for 30s, increasing the damage they take from your area of effect attacks by 125%. This bonus is half as effective on Death Blossom. Domination may only be on 1 target at a time.
[*] Removed Legendary Bull Rush.
[*] Added Legendary Power Strike –Deals Physical damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to you for 30s, causing your damaging abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1. Awards 1 Attack Point.
[/LIST]
[*] Liberator
[LIST]
[*] Legendary Liberation Treatment now also increases healing from the caster’s Liberator heals by 3% on affected allies.
[*] Legendary First Aid now applies a buff to allies over 75% health, causing them to be healed for twice the normal healing of First Aid the next time the ally takes damage.
[*] Legendary Deliverance is now instant cast.
[*] Legendary Medical Facility now Deliverance and Fast Relief splash 50% of their initial healing in an area around affected targets. Removes the cast time for Deliverance and Fast Relief. Removes the Attack Point requirement for Deliverance. Awards 2 Attack Points. Lasts 6s.
[/LIST]
[*] Paladin
[LIST]
[*] Updated the description for the Light’s Favor talent to remove reference to Light’s Rapture.
[*] Updated Legendary Protector’s Fury. It will now always deal damage to attackers while active and has a 30% chance to cast Light’s Balm on the Warrior when damaged.
[*] Updated Legendary Shield Defense. Will not automatically proc if Shield Defense is on cooldown. Automatic procs reduce damage by 25% for 10s. Can occur once per minute.
[*] Sanctuary is now an instant ability and is no longer channeled. Overall duration has not changed.
[/LIST]
[*] Paragon
[LIST]
[*] Force of Will – Now also increases crit damage of Follow Up Attacks by an additional 3/6/9%.
[*] Turn the Blade – Reduced the damage and healing penalty to 20%.
[*] Analyze Weakness – Now reduces the damage and healing penalty from Turn the Blade to 15/10% for Paragon abilities.
[*] Weapon Master – Now also reduces the cooldown of Flurry by 7.5/15s.
[*] Updated both the description and the function of Shifting Blades. The ability should now function as the description indicates. This results in a small increase in damage over how the ability functioned previously.
[*] Updated Precision Strikes to, “Increases the damage of Swift Strike and Setting Moon by 10/20%. Hitting with Swift Strike or Setting Moon applies Precision Strike to the enemy, increasing damage from your finishers and channeled abilities by 10/20% for 6s.”
[*] Fixed an issue with the debuff tooltip for Precise Strikes. It now correctly shows the amount of damage increase it gives.
[*] One Two Punch now also increases the Attack Power and Weapon Damage contribution of non-Follow Up Builders by 5%.
[*] Renamed the debuff applied by Precise Strikes from Precision Strikes to Pinpoint Targeting.
[*] Increased the duration of Pinpoint Targeting to 20s. Up from 6s.
[*] Legendary Rising Waterfall now has the second strike occur 100% of the time. Additional strikes beyond that have a 40% chance of occurring, maximum of 3 total additional strikes.
[*] Legendary Flurry now awards 3 Attack Points over its duration, deals the same damage as the normal version of Flurry, and applies a debuff to the enemy at the end of the channel which increases the damage of the next 2 Follow Up attacks by 50%.
[*] Readiness buff stacks from Legendary Unleashed now only reduce the cooldown of damaging abilities.
[*] Updated Legendary Swift Strike – Deals Physical damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to the enemy for 30s, causing your abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1.
[/LIST]
[*] Reaver
[LIST]
[*] Shadow of Dread now also applies a debuff to the enemy for 15s causing the enemy to take damage equal to 3% of the caster’s attack power each time the caster applies a Reaver DoT to the enemy. The debuff is applied before the DoT effects from Shadow of Dread and is also triggered by DoT refreshes from Septic Wounds.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing Desecrating Blow from refreshing Reaver DoT effects with the Septic Wounds talent.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing Flesh Rot from correctly gaining the bonus from Legendary Shadow of Dread when refreshed by Dire Blow or Desecrating Blow, via Septic Wounds.
[*] Updated Legendary Ravaging Strike – Deals Death damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to you for 30s, causing your damaging abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1. Awards 1 Attack Point.
[/LIST]
[*] Riftblade
[LIST]
[*] Elemental Flux – Increased the Blade buff proc chance bonus to 5/10/15/20/25%.
[*] Burst Synergy – Reduced cooldown from 1 min to 45s.
[*] Improved Frost Strike – Now also increases damage from Finishers by 5/10%.
[*] Elemental Caress – Now increases damage by 3/6%. Up from 2/4%.
[*] Intensify – Modified to, “Increases Critical Hit Chance by 2/4/6% and Critical Hit Damage by 5/10/15%.
[*] Enhanced Burst – Now also adds a 25% chance for hitting with a Burst ability to award 1/2 combo points.
[*] Increased the damage bonus of Planar Blade to 20%. Up from 10%.
[*] Updated how Elemental Weapon is applied to Elemental Touch.
[*] Increased damage from Elemental Touch to 6% of the Warrior’s attack power. Up from 3%.
[*] Legendary Flamespear – Duration reduced to 10s, down from 15s. Total damage dealt remains the same. Bonus damage procs can now be triggered by any damaging ability or autoattack.
[*] Fixed an issue with Legendary Flamespear retaining the benefit of all buffs active when it was cast for its full duration, even if those buffs expire before Legendary Flamespear’s debuff.
[*] Legendary Flamespear’s debuff will no longer proc off of other procs.
[/LIST]
[*] Tempest
[LIST]
[*] Updated both the description and the function of Arc. The ability should now function as the description indicates. This results in a small increase in damage over how the ability functioned previously.
[*] Updated Legendary Shock Pulse – Deals Air damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to you for 30s, causing your damaging abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1. Awards 1 Attack Point.
[*] Legendary Double Pulse can now be used after any other damaging Tempest Pulse ability. It now has a 5s cooldown. Wavelength reduces this cooldown to 0.
[*] Lightning Rod, from Legendary Skyfall, can now hit the same target as Skyfall.
[*] Increased the range of Legendary Shock Pulse back to 30.
[*] Reduced the cooldown of Legendary Double Pulse to 3s.
[*] Increased the damage of Legendary Double Pulse over that of the normal Double Pulse.
[*] Removed an extra % from the end of Legendary Wavelength’s ability description.
[*] Legendary Double Pulse is now automatically cast each time a Tempest Pulse ability, other than Double Pulse, is used. It can still be cast normally after Charged Pulse is used.
[*] Legendary Skyfall will now hit all enemies between the caster and their target, including the target. Up from a limit of 3.
[*] Slightly increased the width of the lightning rod effect from Legendary Skyfall (~30% increase).
[*] Updated the ability description of Legendary Lightning Torrent for better clarity.
[/LIST]
[*] Warchanter
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue where warriors would have negative regen with their eternal weapon equipped and the Warchanter buff Deep Breaths active.
[*] Updated Legendary Seasoned Strike – Deals Physical damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to you for 30s, causing your damaging abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1. Awards 1 Attack Point.
[*] Legendary Turn the Tide now converts overhealing from the ability into an absorb shield.
[*] Legendary I’m With You! now has its healing increased by 50% on allies affected by Stand Tall!. It now awards 3 Attack Points regardless of target.
[*] Legendary We Won’t Falter! now has a base 1s cast time. 50% of overhealing done on an ally affected by the caster’s Stand Tall! is reapplied to the ally after 1.5s.
[/LIST]
[*] Warlord
[LIST]
[*] Reduced the duration of the DoT from Arterial Strike to 6s. The total damage dealt by the DoT remains the same.
[*] Updated the Wave of Steel ability description to show how much damage bonus is gained if the ability is used after a Warlord Finisher.
[*] Three Moves Ahead now increases Wave of Steel and Piercing Thrust damage by 10/20/30%. Up from 5/15/25%.
[*] Combat Training now increases damage by 5/10%. Up from 2/5%.
[*] The Advance Planning buff from King of the Hill now also affects Decisive Strike.
[*] Removed talent Defensive Surge.
[*] New talent: Executioner – Increases the health threshold A Quick Death can be used at by 40%.
[*] Updated Backhand – Deals Physical damage. Weapon damage contribution is increased by 50% for each Attack Point you have on use. Blocking or Dodging an attack will reset the cooldown of Backhand. 10s cooldown.
[*] Updated the description of the talent, Calculating. It now just lists Backhand instead of “all attacks that must follow a Block or Dodge”.
[*] Updated the description of the talent, Seasoned. It now just lists Backhand instead of “all attacks that must follow a Block or Dodge”.
[*] Updated Legendary Everything is a Weapon – Using a Finisher increases the damage of your next 2 non-Finisher attacks by 100%. Up from 1.
[*] Updated Legendary Ready Posture – Increases damage done by 20%. Increases Critical Hit damage and healing by 10%. Reduces ability cost by 15%. Increases the damage of Piercing Thrust by an additional 150% when used after a Warlord Finisher. Dealing damage has a chance to increase the damage of your next A Quick Death by 300%.
[*] Updated Legendary Breaking Blow – Consumes Attack Points. 20 Power cost. Deals weapon damage plus additional damage per Attack Point. Debuffs the enemy, causing a number of your attacks equal to Attack Points consumed to ignore 10% of the enemy’s Armor. 1 point: Breaking Blow ignores 15% Armor, 2 points: Breaking Blow ignores 30% Armor, 3 points: Breaking Blow ignores 50% Armor.
[*] Removed Legendary Sergeant’s Orders.
[*] Added Legendary Empowering Strike – Deals Physical damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to you for 30s, causing your damaging abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1. Awards 1 Attack Point.
[*] Removed talent Defensive Surge.
[*] New talent: Executioner – Increases the health threshold A Quick Death can be used at by 40%.
[*] Increased damage bonus from Down and Dirty to 5/10%. Up from 3/6%.
[*] Changed Legendary Breaking Blow to apply its debuff for 2s per Attack Point consumed instead of for a set number of attacks.
[/LIST]
[*] Void Knight
[LIST]
[*] Removed Legendary Void Propulsion.
[*] Added Legendary Spark - Forces the enemy to attack the Warrior for 3s. Affected enemies deal 10% less damage to the Warrior for 4s. Applies 1 Pact to the Warrior. This can trigger Power Leech.
[*] Due to addition and removal of Legendary abilities from the Void Knight soul, all builds with points spent in the soul have had their talent points refunded.
[*] Discharge now gains 125% damage for each Pact consumed beyond the first. Up from 100%.
[*] Legendary Discharge now also gains an additional 20% increased damage for each Pact still active after the ability consumes Pacts. It now retains its cooldown, regardless of Pacts consumed.
[*] Legendary Spark now applies a visible debuff to the enemy affected by the damage reduction effect.
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[B]DUNGEONS[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Abyssal Precipice (Standard)
[LIST]
[*] Caylx the Ancient deals less damage.
[LIST]
[*] Added encounter wall to Calyx the Ancient encounter.
[/LIST]
[*] Charmer’s Caldera (Standard)
[LIST]
[*] Smouldaron: deals a bit less damage.
[*] Cyclorax: deals slightly less damage.
[*] Ryka Dharvos: deals moderately less damage.
[*] Caelia the Stormtouched: deals less damage.
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[B]GUILDS[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Fixed a bug that when joining a guild, if already inside that guild’s dimension you would not be able to see their item list.
[/LIST]
[B]INSTANCES[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Runic Descent
[LIST]
[*] Fixed issue in Runic Descent and Runic Descent Expert that prevented the Rotting Blossoms spawned by Wormwood from exploding.
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[B]ITEMS[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue where the stats for some Notoriety trinkets weren’t matching their calling or were a couple points under where they should be.
[*] Blighted Riftstalker Crystal
[LIST]
[*] The four piece set bonus has been changed due to the removal of the cooldown to Rift Disturbance. Now increases the damage of Rift Disturbance by 50.
[/LIST]
[*] Blighted Saboteur Crystal
[LIST]
[*] The four piece set bonus has been changed due to the abilities it was affecting no longer existing. Now increases the damage of Satchel Charge by 25.
[/LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue with the Predatory Soulstone. It will now correctly apply its damage bonus to Shadow Fire.
[*] The 2-piece bonus of Nyx’s Pyromancer Crystal now reduces the duration of the damage over time effect applied by Fireball by 3s and increases the speed the effect ticks by 60%.
[*] The 2 piece bonuses from Gilded Reaver Crystal, Blighted Reaver Crystal, Blighted Warlord Crystal now awards Attack Power instead of Endurance.
[*] The 3 piece bonuses from Rasmolov's Reaver Crystal, Calliope's Luminous Reaver Crystal, Calliope's Reaver Crystal, Calliope's Glowing Reaver Crystal, and Rasmolov's Warlord Crystal now awards Attack Power instead of Endurance.
[*] The 4 piece bonus from Rasmolov's Reaver Crystal now reduces the cooldown of Infestation by 4s.
[*] The 4 piece bonus from Calliope's Reaver Crystal now reduces the cooldown of Infestation and Explosive Infestation by 6s.
[*] The 4 piece bonus from Calliope's Glowing Reaver Crystal now reduces the cooldown of Infestation and Explosive Infestation by 6s, and causes them to award an additional Attack Point.
[*] The 4 piece bonus from Calliope's Luminous Reaver Crystal now reduces the cooldown of Infestation and Explosive Infestation by 8s, and causes them to award an additional Attack Point.
[*] The 4 piece bonus from Rasmolov's Warlord Crystal and the 2 piece bonus from Blighted Warlord Crystal now causes Warlord Finishers to increase Attack Power by 60 for 15s.
[*] Updated the description of the 2 piece bonus on Asphodel's Druid Crystal to indicate the correct amount of Armor it causes Fervent Strike to ignore instead of Life resistance. 
[*] New Dynamic loot for Charmer’s Caldera, Abyssal Precipice, and Fall of Lantern Hook: the gear will have the same name and stat ratio as those on live but you can now receive these items based on your current level.
[*] The level 32 gear from World Gear merchants (Iron Pine and the Adventure Dealer) no longer have Set Bonuses.
[*] Some new gear for level 50 players has been added to the Adventure Dealers in Sanctum and Meridian.
[/LIST]
[B]PLANAR ATTUNEMENT[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Tier 1 of Planar Attunement has been opened!
[/LIST]
[B]PROFESSIONS[/B]
[LIST]
[*] The crafting mats for Mighty Powersurge have been adjusted to be consistent with Brightsurge Vials.
[/LIST]
[B]QUESTS[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue with the “I’ll Just Have a Sip” and “What’s Your Poison” quests in Stillmoor where the debuff wasn’t correctly affecting an NPC.
[*] Made some spelling corrections to quest rewards.
[*] Fixed bugs with daily quest completion counts and made the count increment only when reward is claimed.
[/LIST]
[B]RAIDS[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Greenscale’s Blight
[LIST]
[*] Adjusted leash point for Greenscale encounter.
[*] Adjusted leash point for Prince Hylas encounter.
[*] Adjusted leash point for Oracle Aleria encounter.
[*] Adjusted leash point for Duke letareus encounter.
[/LIST]
[*] Gilded Prophecy
[LIST]
[*] Added encounter wall and leash radius to Uruluuk encounter.
[*] Added encounter wall to Thalguur encounter.
[*] Adjusted leash point for Anrak the Foul.
[/LIST]
[*] Drowned Halls
[LIST]
[*] Adjusted leash point for Assault Commander Jorb.
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[B]STARTING ZONE[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Terminus
[LIST]
[*] The Guardian fanatics in Terminus are now a little less fanatical.
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[B]SUMMERFEST[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Summerfest officially begins on Thursday, July 12, 2018 at 3:30 PM server time and runs until Thursday, August 2, 2018 at 3:30 PM server time.
[*] The druids of Scarwood Reach have demanded a much bigger replanting effort this Summerfest, so there are three times the amount of trees available in the scavenger hunt.
[*] Reduced the amount of Summerfest fungi that were placed tantalizingly out of reach, and uncollectable.
[/LIST]
[B]TOOLTIPS[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Ability tooltips should now show the accurate value.
[*] Fixed the incorrect tooltip on Hit for T1 Classic Raids.
[*] Fixed an issue that made disabling the tooltip anchor not actually disable ability tooltips.
[/LIST]
[B]UI[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an incorrect tooltip for Defensive Posture.
[*] Fixed a bug where temporary or reactive abilities would disappear from your UI upon logging in or reloading your UI.
[*] Fixed issue with previewing items causing other equipment to overlap with wardrobe previews.
[/LIST]
[B]ZONE CONTENT[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Correctly leveled mobs that were too high level for zones due to prime forced mentoring.
[/LIST]
[B]ZONE EVENTS[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Zone events will have significantly more invasions spawning. Invasions are stronger verses zone population. Wardstones will be attackable by invasions sooner.
[/LIST]

[B]Additional 4.5 Patch Notes (Prime)[/B]

CALLINGS
[LIST]
[*] Mage
[LIST]
[*] Chloromancer
[LIST]
[*] Essence Conversion will no longer consume damage modifying buffs.
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[*] Rogue
[LIST]
[*] Saboteur
[LIST]
[*] Corrected the name of the Detonate damage from Scatter Sticky Bomb. Previously it was showing in combat logs as Scatter Sticky Bomb Boof. 
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[*] Warrior
[LIST]
[*] Updated Legendary Tactics. It can now proc, at most, every 3s. Increased damage per proc. Previously there was no internal cooldown on the damage proc.
[*] Updated the ability descriptions for Empowering Strike, Power Strike, Swift Strike, Ravaging Strike, Shock Pulse and Seasoned Strike to reflect the changes to Legendary Tactics.
[*] Tempest
[LIST]
[*] Increased damage buff from Empower to 10%. Up from 5%.
[/LIST]
[*] Warlord
[LIST]
[*] Updated how bonus damage is calculated for Piercing Thrust and Wave of Steel when these abilities are used after a Warlord finisher. 
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[/LIST]

[b]RIFT 4.5: 7/11/2018[/b]

[b]== LIVE SERVER NOTES ==[/b]
[B]ACHIEVEMENTS[/B]
[LIST]
[*] The achievement “Caught Them All (Almost) now only requires 250 minions (was 300). The previous tier of minion collecting has been reduced to 175 (was 200).
[/LIST]

[B]BANK[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Fixed a bug that would not allow you to move items directly from your shard vault to your bank.
[/LIST]

[B]CALLINGS[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue causing many procs to incorrectly proc other procs. [LIST]

[*] Removed Legendary Grave Rot.
[*] Added Legendary Desecrate – Deals Death damage based on the number of stacks of Deathly Calling on the enemy. Curses the enemy for 20s, increasing damage taken from the Mage’s pet by 5% per stack of Deathly Calling on the enemy when Desecrate is cast.

[*] Fixed an issue that would prevent Lich Form from being cast.
[*] Fixed an issue when a Mage has both Legendary Condemn and Legendary Reaper’s Touch, Deathly Calling would not stack higher than 5 while Legendary Reaper’s Touch was active.
[*] Increased the duration of Legendary Reaper’s Touch to 16s. Increased damage of both the damage over time portion and the damage burst at the end.
[*] Putrify now causes the Necromancer pet to apply the maximum number of stacks of Deathly Calling to the enemy. (i.e. It will now apply 10 stacks if you have Legendary Condemn).
[*] Legendary Condemn now also increases the Mage’s damage to the enemy by 1% per stack.
[/LIST]

[LIST]
[*] Updated the talent description for Pyromancer’s Vengeance to accurately reflect how the talent functions. It now indicates it increases the proc chance of Pyromancer’s Blessing by 2/4% per stack instead of 1 / 2% per stack. [LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue where Wind Chill would consume a stack from Pyromancer’s Internalize Charge.
[/LIST]

[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue preventing multiple Mages from having Lingering Torment, from Legendary Neddra’s Grasp, active on an enemy at the same time.

[/LIST]
[/LIST]

[LIST]
[*] Farseer
[LIST]

[/LIST]

[LIST]
[*] Bard
[LIST]

[LIST]

[/LIST]

[LIST]

[LIST]

[LIST]

Damaging single target abilities apply Domination to the enemy, for 30s, increasing the damage they take from your area of effect attacks by 125%. This bonus is half as effective on Death Blossom. [LIST]

[LIST]

[*] Fixed an issue preventing Desecrating Blow from refreshing Reaver DoT effects with the Septic Wounds talent.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing Flesh Rot from correctly gaining the bonus from Legendary Shadow of Dread when refreshed by Dire Blow or Desecrating Blow, via Septic Wounds.
[*] Updated Legendary Ravaging Strike – Deals Death damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to you for 30s, causing your damaging abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1. Awards 1 Attack Point.

[LIST]

[*] Elemental Caress – Now increases damage by 3/6%. Up from 2/4%.

[/LIST]

[LIST]

[*] Increased the range of Legendary Shock Pulse back to 30.
[*] Reduced the cooldown of Legendary Double Pulse to 3s.
[*] Increased the damage of Legendary Double Pulse over that of the normal Double Pulse.

[LIST]

[*] Added Legendary Empowering Strike – Deals Physical damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to you for 30s, causing your damaging abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1. Awards 1 Attack Point.

[h1]What is Summerfest?[/h1]
You may be wondering about the origins of Summerfest.

While some of the history is lost to time, many scholars believe that Summerfest dates back to ancient elven rituals involving burning sacrifices inside wicker figures. Of course, most elves would prefer to forget these barbaric references to their past. In fact, such practices are now forbidden by both High Elves and Kelari alike, although sometimes alluded to by disgruntled Dwarves. What remains in modern Telara is a celebration of flames for all Ascended to enjoy.

Summerfest is now the holiday that marks the longest days of summer in Telara. Ascended continue to celebrate ancient traditions and have fun, even in the sweltering heat. This helps lighten the distract celebrants from the stress of the near-constant threats against Telara.

So don’t be late! Just like summer itself, the festivities won’t last long. Play RIFT or RIFT Prime and don’t forget to check out the seasonal in-game store for even more Summerfest goodies!

notes.title: Get Ready to Ride
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/3b0ad814af04aaedb2643a0ad8a29922c7a12e8c.jpg[/img]

Check out RIFT’s newest mount and get ready to #ShowUsYourSnail.

[h1]Apocalyptic Snail Rush[/h1]
The Plane of Earth contains vast desert wastes left behind by species such as the Architects. Existence can be difficult there, even for hardy species such as ogres. Some turn to an ascetic life contemplating the path of the Cosmic Rhinoceros, while others who have not given up their desire for acquiring plunder become brutal raiders. These ogre raiders travel the wastes on their fearsome Apocalypse Snails, one of the few other creatures that can both survive in the wastes, and carry the tremendous bulk of the ogre raiders, and their prodigious plunder. A number of these mounts have traveled through the rifts and have become prized by collectors who admire the wasteland chic desire, and how the snails will eat anything, often to the detriment of their keepers.

notes.title: Summer 2018 RIFT Updates - Official Dev Letter
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/547c20183d090381ab7b58ab4e4411317c77ddfa.jpg[/img]

Hail, Ascended!

A busy six weeks have passed since our spring update letter, and while it's not quite officially summer, the Rift team is full steam ahead preparing for long days and too-hot weekends where you can escape the heat outside by playing Rift! (If you're in the southern hemisphere, clearly you should also bundle up in a blanket with some Rift in the chilly evenings, just saying.)

Grab your sunglasses and a cold drink and let's get to it - and don't forget your towel!

[h1][u]Latest Balance Updates[/u][/h1]

The recent work on soul balance picked up speed with a significant set of ability updates in 4.4 Hotfix #13, published live on May 16th. This first pass brought a lot of focus on Warrior souls, with the goal of bringing them up to a more competitive state and more fun to play. If you were considering a new alt, now would be a good time to try a Warrior! Additional fixes went in for Clerics, Rogues, and Mages, as well as overall buff stacking groups between callings.

These balance changes are definitely not considered the end of ongoing soul work, but so far appear to bring us to a more even baseline for soul performance from which more targeted changes can be made. High on that list are Legendary Abilities, additional Warrior improvements, and a look at Clerics for both healing and DPS.

We'd like to offer great appreciation to those players who joined us on PTS Omega to review, parse, and give feedback on the combined changes prior to them going live! You can expect some more future patches to roll out in a similar manner, where a set of changes gets compiled over time, sent to PTS, then reviewed before integrating into the Live and Prime update schedule.

Speaking of PTS and content testing, we're about to have the ability to run both PTS Alpha and PTS Omega at the same time with the same patch, with the shards running different (Live and Prime) rulesets. When we get ready to enable them, we'll be taking PTS offline for a couple of days for behind-the-scenes work. It'll be worth it to be able to get both types of testing at the same time!

[h1][u]Latest Content Updates[/u][/h1]

The Seeker scavenger hunt event started on May 16th, and to be completely honest, there's some pleasant surprise at the collaboration we've seen! You've been teaming up to share coordinates and discussing the hunt on the forums - Rift players are the best. :) Good luck to those still working on the collection, and to those awaiting the challenge results!

Over on Prime, Greenscale made his grand appearance and many of the Ascended rose to the challenge - some of them even met with victory. If you're not quite raid-ready yet, don't fret! Additional changes went in to adjust overpowered Sliver boss abilities, and to smooth out the Prime experience curve. The update also reduced the platinum costs of expanded Role slots for those of you who prefer to have a spec ready for every situation.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/95d0c6117764869534f01055d3d8421fc4fa46d2.png[/img]

[h1][u]The Near Horizon[/u][/h1]

While the recent hotfixes have a strong balance focus, on the mid-term horizon we have folks already working on some really great summer events and laying the groundwork for some of our longer term content goals for Live as the Prophecy of Ahnket storyline continues. More frequent bonus events, like this last weekend’s bonus experience on both Live and Prime, are also in the cards. It's hard to talk details on some of these until the patches get closer to complete, but there are definitely some beans to spill. Not too many, though - don't want to spoil the picnic!

Summerfest approaches with the promise of relaxation in Telara - who says an Ascended can't take a vacation from saving the world? New art and dimension items are rolling in, and this writer might be biased, but our artists are killing it! There's also some cleanup work being done to improve the event experience this year.

Summerfest isn't the only world event on the horizon. We've mentioned previously that the team is working on the prelude event for River of Souls on Prime.  While these events may not be in the timeline for Live, they’re going to be fun and challenging content that we’ll be looking to release on all worlds! In that process we've uncovered other events from Rift's past that were not tied to specific holidays or raids, and the team is working on bringing these back for an encore on both the Live servers and Prime.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/7177dd96f684c21e98341fabe6838fe6fcdf41bc.png[/img]

[h1][u]Live[/u][/h1]

We have more than balance updates and events planned for Live servers this summer. The team is committed to improving the overall experience on Live servers, and some of the short- and mid-term focuses are:
[list]
 	[*]Bring more exciting rewards to the Daily Reward Calendar on Live, more in line with the Prime rewards.[/*]
 	[*]Add rare mount drops to Expert Dungeons and Raids on Live.  These extra rewards for play have been great on Prime, and this one is an idea that’s definitely worth taking to all servers.[/*]
 	[*]Revamp and reduce the credit store on Live. We're looking keenly at player feedback, especially some recent well-presented player discussions, to improve this area. While we view the store as a place for cosmetics, convenience, and some amount of ability for newer players to catch up with their friends, we don’t want it to be perceived as gameplay replacement, so we’ll be making upcoming changes with that in mind.[/*]
 	[*]Some may have noticed the recent trend on the Rift store to offer the latest mounts without releasing them inside of a lockbox, and you should expect more of that.[/*]
 	[*]As an advanced Soul Balance topic, revisiting the Eternal Weapons and their impact on builds.[/*]
 	[*]Planar Fragments, addressing their level of RNG and costs to upgrade.[/*]
 	[*]Warfront queue level banding is going to be getting a look in an upcoming test.  The more level bands and warfronts there are, the longer queueing takes.  Our goal here is to speed up the queues while keeping gameplay fun.[/*]
[/list]
We've got a jam-packed summer ahead of us, Ascended. We hope to see you well and victorious in Telara over the next few months!

- The Rift Team

Want to chat with us about this dev letter? Post your comments below!

The Planar Plucker was built from scavenged bits of Crucia's defeated army; our take on beating swords to ploughshares! This brand new mount model is ready to help you harvest plants and wood without dismounting!


[b][u]RIFT Live store update![/u][/b]

If you do any harvesting at all, you know the drill; run to a node, dismount, harvest, remount, run to the next node. Hop off, dig, hop on, run, hop off, dig, hop on... it is time-wasting, achy-breaky work! Stoop no more!

Ride high and reap well with the brand new Planar Plucker! This beauty comes with a lifetime warranty. You'll never have to take it in for servicing, and thanks to Crucia's stunning no-waste fuel cells, the Plucker is entirely energy efficient!  By the way, no need to mention to her that we made off with the tech. That might not end well.

These are rare and highly sought-after mounts, and like the Greenata, is available for [b][u]direct sale on the store[/u][/b]! They go on sale April 25th, for a limited time. The Planar Plucker is available only on RIFT Live; Prime folks don't even know who Crucia IS yet. They'll find out soon enough...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/1443ab5cd7dfc66238ba7c16098cff92dd815b10.jpg[/img]

We're also bringing back the White Squirrel Mount for direct sale! As much as we all love squirrels, they have not managed the leap to Prime yet, so they will be offered on our Live service only!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/3f50a8a2e4a9c659d907b07530b5612ecc75e370.jpg[/img]

Many of you have asked for combat pet skins to come back, and in honor of Defiance 2050's Beta weekends, we're bringing back the Hellbug combat pet skin bundles! A different hellbug skin for Druids, Necromancers, Rogues and Warriors! Snap them up fast! Available on the RIFT store on our Live service only!


[b][u]RIFT Prime Store update![/u][/b]

We have some lovely new offerings for citizens of Vigil! On April 25th, you'll be able to collect lovely new-to-you mounts, companion pets and costumes! All are available for credits on the RIFT in-game store.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/8fe8282e5d85e882007ee3f740186ca3002e14ff.jpg[/img]

[b]MOUNTS:[/b]

[b]Aurora[/b], regal and stunning in every shofting shades of blue, will increase your speed by 60%, and will scale up if you acquire faster mounts over time. Aurora was first made available on Live through the Carnival of the Ascended, and she has now made her way to Vigil!

We know many of you have enjoyed your Armored White Tiger, but who doesn't love to switch things up now and then? Let's take a ride on the dark side with the [b]Armored Black Tiger[/b]. It's ebon hues are perfect for formal occasions or for sneaking up on your enemies at night. He offers 60% speed boost, or will match the level of your fastest mount.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/1d7e8391cca8fa670027ba5261c087dc01d07323.png[/img]


[b]COMPANION PETS:[/b]

It's raining cats and dogs - here, take one of each!

[b]Corpus Kitty[/b] - everyone's favorite undead cat. Clearly she wasn't ready to leave this plane after her seven lives were used up! A perfect companion for practitioners of dark arts, or those who just want something a little less ordinary.

[b]Kirby[/b] - you've seen him lounging magnificently on our livestreams, and now you can help Kirby get the exercise he so desperately needs!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/1d7e8391cca8fa670027ba5261c087dc01d07323.png[/img]


[b]COSTUMES:[/b]

A change of costume may make all the difference. Don the [b]Centurion's Bundle[/b] or [b]Sanctuary Guard's Bundle[/b] and shine in any circumstance! Completely stain-proof, these outfits will not be ruined after a long night's hunting foray or drunken adventure through the dankest dungeons!

notes.title: DEV NOTE: The Path Ahead - Spring Edition!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/8178ae6d857df7b70f2ce0e08ca1d8fa468c8fa5.jpg[/img]

Ascended, we are so happy to have you with us, on Live and Prime. It’s been a busy year and we want to share what’s coming next! Grab a mug of ale or a cup of coffee and settle in...


[b][u]ALL RIFT SERVICES:[/u][/b]

There are a lot of causes for lag, most of which occur in the wild spaces between your system and hours.  So let’s talk about a type of lag we [u]can[/u] address internally in our services: [b]Ability Lag[/b]. We’ve made a number of adjustments to load-heavy abilities on some classes, and load distribution on our servers, with more to come--we’ve seen a dramatic reduction in reports of Ability Lag. This doesn’t mean that we’re done yet, or that it doesn’t still occur; we continue to watch and review, and will take more action over time as we identify culprits.

[b]Balance:[/b]

Balance is a common and repeated request, and one we take seriously. We know that souls and challenges evolve over time, along with the game. Again, we plan slow and careful adjustments over time, rather than massive, sweeping changes. You can expect more of these to come throughout the evolution of RIFT on both Live and Prime services. Here are the tweaks we are making this patch on both Live and Prime services, focused heavily on [b]Warriors[/b], who really needed the love... GROUP HUG! (read on below for more Warrior adjustments on Prime only)
[list]
 	[*][b]Warrior – Void Knight:[/b] The cooldown for Tempest has been removed. Damage has been slightly reduced but threat has been increased.[/*]
 	[*][b]Warrior – Void Knight:[/b] Increased the threat gain on the following abilities: Ragestorm, Unstable Reaction, and Discharge.[/*]
 	[*][b]Warrior – Paladin:[/b] The cooldown for Sweeping Strike has been removed. Damage has been slightly reduced but threat has been increased.[/*]
 	[*][b]Warrior – Paladin:[/b] Increased the threat gain on the following abilities: Light’s Vengeance, Light’s Reprisal, and Vengeful Decree.[/*]
 	[*][b]Rogue – Riftstalker:[/b] The cooldown for Rift Disturbance has been removed. Damage has been slightly reduced but threat has been increased.[/*]
 	[*][b]Mage – Frostkeeper:[/b] The threat generated from Earthen Rapport has been reduced.[/*]
 	[*][b]Mage – Frostkeeper:[/b] Players and pets can now only have 1 stack of a Frostkeeper barrier on them at a time.[/*]
[/list]
 

[b]General Content:[/b]

On the general content front, Lantern Hook has received some attention. Pyromaster Cortinald will no longer be able to ignore taunts, while Tarthak the Immolator’s health will scale more appropriately.

 

[b]PVP Bolstering Adjustment[/b]

In PvP, we’re introducing an adjustment for bolstering at lower levels (10-50), wherein they use the same bolstering effect as level 50+ Warfronts. We ask that you please post feedback of any bugs you may encounter with this change. Here is the official feedback thread - we really appreciate your input AFTER the patch goes live, of course!

 

[b]Guild Creation:[/b]

Creating a Guild through the game UI will now cost one platinum, to match the purchase rate of a Guild Creation Scroll.

 

[b]Summer is Coming![/b]

We’ve started work on Summerfest 2018, and hope to talk about it on this week’s Livestream! We think you'll love the theme for this year, so tune in and have a look-see! Yes, this WILL be on Live and Prime!

 

 
[h1][b][u]Specific only to Live: NA/EU[/u][/b][/h1]
Level Boosting potions have been examined, tested and reformulated so that they will award the proper amount of experience for the applicable level.

In the Bastion of Steel Raid, we’ve taken a wrench to Vindicator MK1’s Burning Ground ability, so that it can no longer affect players outside of the instance. It’s an edge case, but an annoying one!

 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/627de8b9369a66bde5c7a539724b818f5bcb0a7c.jpg[/img]
[h1][u]Greenscale can hardly wait to taste you... [url=https://rift.pictures/](credit: RIFT Pictures)[/url][/u][/h1]
 
[h1][b][u]Specific to Prime: Vigil[/u][/b][/h1]
[h1]CONTENT UNLOCKS![/h1]
Progression is at the top of many current discussions across our many communication channels, and as the Vigil server population slowly matures (hey, not everyone is max level yet!), it’s time to plot a course for the next month!

Heads up – [b]Greenscale is coming soon[/b]! Everyone’s favorite voracious chomper, the first Dragon to be encountered on Telara will show up in late April. Will It be wholesale slaughter, or will your guild persevere?

Meanwhile, the path to Greenscale is already opening, with the release of the [b]Life Saga[/b] and [b]Death Saga[/b], just in time for the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/rift/announcements/detail/1674651708337653789]Month 2 Vigil Challenge[/url]! These will automatically unlock at 9:00 AM PDT, April 11<sup>th</sup>!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/5d3e630e2db99f8f8ff1dbcd2407e842fd73d09d.jpg[/img]
[h1][u]Runic Descent looks so peaceful at sunset... [url=https://rift.pictures/](credit: RIFT Pictures)[/url][/u][/h1]

Not enough content for ya? No problem - we’re also unlocking:
[list]
 	[*]Expert Deepstrike Mines[/*]
 	[*]Expert Runic Descent[/*]
 	[*]Expert Abyssal Precipice[/*]
 	[*]Expert Charmer’s Caldera![/*]
[/list]
 

Speaking of the [b]Caldera[/b], we’ve smacked around the bosses for ya in [b]Standard mode[/b]:
Smouldaron: Deals a bit less damage

Cyclorax: Deals slightly less damage

Ryka Dharvos: Deals moderately less damage

Caelia the Stormtouched: Deals less damage

 
[b]Darkening Deeps Expert[/b] is coming around the bend, expected to open next week or slightly later!

 
[b]Blighted Antechamber[/b] is anticipated in the upcoming weeks as well. In both cases, we’re making sure the QA folks get a good look at them before being released to the wilds of Vigil!

 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/657d3aadd272c920cd3b12354fd89919f9ab1cab.jpg[/img]
[b]PVP Warfront:[/b] Port Scion returns to the PvP Warfront list, as part of our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/rift/announcements/detail/1674651708337653789]2nd Monthly Prime: Vigil Challenge![/url]  We’re looking forward to feedback on this zone; in the past it’s been love it or hate it, with very little in between.

[h1][u]Port Scion from Stonefield... so lovely and inviting!  [url=https://rift.pictures/](credit: RIFT Pictures)[/url][/u][/h1]
[h1][/h1]

[h1][b]BALANCE![/b][/h1]
Prime-only balance updates focus largely on adjusting the [b]Warrior[/b], who needed the most help in this brave new world. As with balance adjustments on Live servers, we will watch, measure and gather both data and personal feedback, continuing to adjust over time as needed:
[list]
 	[*][b]Mage – Frostkeeper:[/b] Healing procced by Earthen Barrier has been reduced. Boop![/*]
 	[*][b]Warrior – Paladin:[/b] Fixed an issue where when using Shield of the Hero, auto-attacks would do zero damage. Bing![/*]
 	[*][b]Warrior – Champion:[/b] Slightly increased damage of Mighty Blow. Bam![/*]
 	[*][b]Warrior – Champion:[/b] Moderately increased the damage of Titan’s Strike. Pow![/*]
 	[*][b]Warrior – Champion:[/b] Greatly increased the damage of Bladefury. BOOM![/*]
 	[*][b]Warrior – Paragon:[/b] Increased the damage of Shifting Blades. Yeah![/*]
 	[*][b]Warrior – Paragon:[/b] Greatly increased the damage of Way of the Wind. Whoa![/*]
 	[*][b]Warrior – Paragon:[/b] Slightly increased the damage of Deadly Parity. Take that![/*]
[/list]
So hug a Warrior today... unless you're in PvP, in which case, smack 'em hard, then run away fast!

 
[h1]Prime PVP[/h1]
PvP Queues taking forever? Level 50 Warfront Balance? We hear you like it when folks die. Message received!

Both damage (increased) and healing (lowered) have been adjusted pretty heavily.  Please continue to post feedback and we'll continue to tune toward fun.  Thank you!

 
[h1]What’s NEXT for Prime?[/h1]
Plenty! Now that we’ve been at this for a month, we’re getting a clearer picture of where the path leads. River of Souls is next up for scrutiny, Combat Balance continues, Dungeon Balance is under further review.

The first slivers glimmer on the horizon and are expected later this month - you can soon experience [b]Gilded Prophecy[/b] and [b]Drowned Halls[/b] again, for the first time!

We’re working on UI to support 20-player LFR.

[b]Summerfest[/b] will come to Prime this year in addition to Live servers, marking the first full-on festival to run on Vigil!

And this just in… the team is starting internal testing on post-Greenscale world events! We can’t spill ALL the beans, or there will be nothing left to talk about, but hey, [url=http://forums.riftgame.com/general-discussions/news-announcements/504014-riftstream-04-13-winning-shiny-stories-prime-challenge-path-ahead.html]drop us some questions[/url] for the Livestream on Friday!


RIFT ON!

~The RIFT Team
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/5eebd87961f2277099fa121a2208805588555c9b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Happy 5th, RiftDimensionAddicts!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/344ee93576974369ba4ac2c4b435179b60a3403d.jpg[/img]

We wish Dimension Addicts a very happy [b]fifth[/b] anniversary! Let's get to know Kitasia and how she came to create one of the most amazing resource sites for folks who are... well... Dimension Addicts!


If you've ever thought about building out your dream home in RIFT, you'll know that there is an incredible array of items - many thousands, in fact! Entering your empty Dimension for the first time may also be daunting. It's tempting to just drop all your Dim items in a pile, but you can do so much more!

Where to start? Where can you get the bits and bobs to make YOUR perfect, personal zone? Most of all, HOW can you learn to build the epic works of art you've seen online in RIFT? Kitasia and her site, [url=http://riftdimensionaddicts.com/home]RIFTDimensionAddicts.com[/url] are here to help!

 [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/b368ed239c0be24f25b8ba2ded27ae786f1214d2.jpg[/img]


[b]Hi there! Tell us a little bit about the person behind Kitasia, and how she came to play RIFT.[/b]

I am just a plain ordinary mom. Nothing special. I like to make crafts. I am really, really bad at it, but that does not stop me. You know the "ugly birthday card" kid? When you were in grade school and someone had a birthday, the whole class made them a card. There was always the one kid, who for the life of them couldn't make a nice card - that was me - I am the ugly birthday card kid. I have [u]lots[/u] of imagination. I can visualize [u]so[/u] many beautiful things, but in real life, they just turn out to be the ugly birthday card. That doesn't stop me!

My husband and I played open beta for many games; we enjoyed seeing what was up and coming. Naturally, when a new game called RIFT offered open beta, we tried it. The rifts, the invasions - I couldn't believe how amazingly interactive the world was. You didn't know what was going on - it was chaos and so much fun. When it was over, I was sad. I wanted to play more, unlike any beta we tried before. RIFT came with a one month sub so my husband bought it for me. After that 30 days, I asked if we could afford just one more month of Rift [u]and[/u] the other game we had played for years. Just a few days into that month I told him we needed to let our friends know we were leaving our other game. I was hooked, and knew I wasn't going anywhere anytime soon.

I don't remember my first character. We were up waiting for servers to come up for the first time. We didn't go get food or anything because we were so excited. They came up we played for about 15 min before we realized we were starving. So we ran to get food. We came back, logged in and my character was standing there in her undies. I had been hacked. I couldn't kill anything with my fists, so I put in a CS ticket, and made a new toon... ~Kitasia~

 [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/df18dffd60262bf17aa42219485d079ba93efb4a.jpg[/img]

[b]Did you start out as an adventurer in RIFT? When did you discover your deep love of Dimensions? Did you ever end up getting to max level after you were distracted by your new hobby?[/b]

Definitely an adventurer. I loved questing and I am a total quest reader.

We heard the new expansion Storm Legion was going to have player housing I was like WOOT! I [u]love[/u] having a house. When the expansion opened on the Public Test Server I discovered I could move items exactly how I liked, not simply placing things in a house. I almost fell out of my chair! I made this giant mushroom staircase with a cute little deck on top. When Storm Legion went live, I was either building or earning reputation points for items; we had very few items to chose from at that time and many were found on reputation vendors. Grinding rep has the natural consequences of leveling you, so I always seem to get max level very easily.

[b]What drove you to the insanity of starting up the Dimension Addicts site?[/b]

Many years back, I was sick with a fever of 105 for almost two weeks. When I didn't die, which was amazing in itself, I very quickly discovered many things were not "right" anymore. I couldn't control my emotions. I ended up having super high empathy, I couldn't do simple math, my memory was completely messed up and I got confused easily.

The worst part of all was that I could no longer understand what I was trying to look for on a website if it had the wrong colors, was too cluttered, or had articles jumbled everywhere. In turn, my illness made other things pop - I see things much differently now. It is like everything had a beauty intensified. With colors and smells, I could see things anew. Looking at rings on a tree stump, for example, I could see the glimmer in the wood that I never noticed previously.

Dimension items were easy for me to look at and find other uses for, beyond the obvious. I could visualize [u]so[/u] much to be made out of the simplest items. With Dimensions, I found something I could do that I could make as beautiful as the world around me for the first time. 

Then came the "Joys of Dimensions" contest by Trion. You could win these beautiful [url=http://dimensionaddicts.com/node/392]Prize Blooming Faer Cages[/url]. I wanted them soooo badly that it hurt inside thinking I couldn't get them. At that time, you could only have one dimension per character, so I ripped my dimension apart and started over ~Sweethearts~@deepwood was born. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/95976e59632e7baea766cc0c494cce611e821e68.jpg[/img]

When the contest was over I didn't know I had won anything. I started tearing down parts of my dim to make a bathroom in it, when up pops Elrar to let me know I had won the [u][b]grand prize[/b][/u]. I got my CAGES - I was jumping for joy. I was also informed I had won a computer... which took a while to sink in.

I grew up with the internet being very laggy. I didn't know it was [u]not[/u] normal to stutter through a game. I was playing Rift at 1 frame every 1 to 3 seconds. I was here when I was there. That was normal to me and I thought everyone played that way. When I received that computer, my tech jumped 15 years in one go. I could move dim items quickly and accurately. I had to build another dimension.

Because of my memory issues, I needed to use sites to tell me where items were, and what they were. Unfortunately, I was unable to understand the sites and ended crying out of frustration. Our friend Courdilla suggested that I make my own database so I could control the colors and how the items are listed. I laughed. I thought he was being funny and trying to make me feel better. I knew that making a database was impossible because I didn't know the first thing about it. My husband and Courdilla said they could put the hard stuff together for me and I just needed to add the items. They said [u]that[/u] was actually the hard part because it was time intensive.

At that time a group of us had been calling each other "dimension addicts" and someone made the chat channel in game a few days before, so I said let us call it RiftDimensionAddicts for fun. At this point, it was just going to be my personal space. So I made colors that worked for me and played at making a banner. It was just something fun to decorate and set up. I started adding images and learned simple Photoshop. I was learning new stuff, with help of many sticky notes. There were sticky notes [u]everywhere[/u]. So many that my husband found a program called Sticky Notes just so I could keep them digital and off the floor. I was having so much fun. When it was done, it looked nice, so Courd suggested I share it with people. It was ok, even though we had 2 dim item sites already; it was something I could share with my friends.

Little did I know how many items would be added in the future, how many times the prices would change, or that the item names themselves would change.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/a72d1e131823e01cfb3f28a84e0bf4a9715d647a.jpg[/img]

[b]How long do you spend on the site? Do you get any support from Trion staff on info and upcoming items?[/b]

Making the initial site took about a week or two. The updates however - some take longer to add than it took to make the site itself! Some updates we've had consisted of double what we had in the beginning. So I spend countless hours finding and adding each item. In the beginning, I had to find EVERY item in the game on my own to add it.

My first help from Trion was Morgana. I was so scared to ask her, but I needed help with getting a guild high enough to get some images of the guild dims. My stomach was turning and I was shaking scared, but I did it, and survived! Then Morticus opened communication channels to the dimensioneers. This helped so much - we were amazed by him and his help. Then in comes Tacitus, who just threw the doors wide open with "Here I am what do you need? I'm here to answer any question you may have, to fix anything I can, and be here for all you dimensionerds." Tacitus has been invaluable to all of us. He takes extra care to help me find or understand where something can be found so I can add it. Brasse is always there with her support and kindness anytime I need her, too. I can not even begin to describe how grateful I am to everyone on the staff who takes the time to answer my questions and needs.


[b]Are you among the first to submit Dimension bugs? Are you part of a group of likeminded Dim folks?[/b]

I do spend a lot of time on the PTS looking for dim bugs. Sometimes I don't realize its a bug and just say something. I am always there the second I know the PTS has been updated with dim items.

I love being part of the dimensionaddicts channel in game. It is somewhere that all us dimensionerds can get together and get help and be help for others. Anyone can join it and chat with us.

 

[b]How can other players help keep Dimension Addicts going?[/b]

Be sure to send me an email through the "contact us" button if you see any wrong information. I misspell, miss items, prices change, names change. I cant catch it all!

Also, we added a donate button to the front page. Because the database is so extensive we have to use a paid hosting service. Most sites offset this by adding advertisements to their pages. With the nature of why the site was created that won't work. If you can't donate its ok, don't feel bad!
I would just like to say Thank You to everyone over the last 5 years with your support and kindness. Here's to 5 more and beyond!

Always remember:

notes.title: Happy 5th, RiftDimensionAddicts!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/344ee93576974369ba4ac2c4b435179b60a3403d.jpg[/img]

We wish Dimension Addicts a very happy [b]fifth[/b] anniversary! Let's get to know Kitasia and how she came to create one of the most amazing resource sites for folks who are... well... Dimension Addicts!


If you've ever thought about building out your dream home in RIFT, you'll know that there is an incredible array of items - many thousands, in fact! Entering your empty Dimension for the first time may also be daunting. It's tempting to just drop all your Dim items in a pile, but you can do so much more!

Where to start? Where can you get the bits and bobs to make YOUR perfect, personal zone? Most of all, HOW can you learn to build the epic works of art you've seen online in RIFT? Kitasia and her site, [url=http://riftdimensionaddicts.com/home]RIFTDimensionAddicts.com[/url] are here to help!

 [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/b368ed239c0be24f25b8ba2ded27ae786f1214d2.jpg[/img]


[b]Hi there! Tell us a little bit about the person behind Kitasia, and how she came to play RIFT.[/b]

I am just a plain ordinary mom. Nothing special. I like to make crafts. I am really, really bad at it, but that does not stop me. You know the "ugly birthday card" kid? When you were in grade school and someone had a birthday, the whole class made them a card. There was always the one kid, who for the life of them couldn't make a nice card - that was me - I am the ugly birthday card kid. I have [u]lots[/u] of imagination. I can visualize [u]so[/u] many beautiful things, but in real life, they just turn out to be the ugly birthday card. That doesn't stop me!

My husband and I played open beta for many games; we enjoyed seeing what was up and coming. Naturally, when a new game called RIFT offered open beta, we tried it. The rifts, the invasions - I couldn't believe how amazingly interactive the world was. You didn't know what was going on - it was chaos and so much fun. When it was over, I was sad. I wanted to play more, unlike any beta we tried before. RIFT came with a one month sub so my husband bought it for me. After that 30 days, I asked if we could afford just one more month of Rift [u]and[/u] the other game we had played for years. Just a few days into that month I told him we needed to let our friends know we were leaving our other game. I was hooked, and knew I wasn't going anywhere anytime soon.

I don't remember my first character. We were up waiting for servers to come up for the first time. We didn't go get food or anything because we were so excited. They came up we played for about 15 min before we realized we were starving. So we ran to get food. We came back, logged in and my character was standing there in her undies. I had been hacked. I couldn't kill anything with my fists, so I put in a CS ticket, and made a new toon... ~Kitasia~

 [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/df18dffd60262bf17aa42219485d079ba93efb4a.jpg[/img]

[b]Did you start out as an adventurer in RIFT? When did you discover your deep love of Dimensions? Did you ever end up getting to max level after you were distracted by your new hobby?[/b]

Definitely an adventurer. I loved questing and I am a total quest reader.

We heard the new expansion Storm Legion was going to have player housing I was like WOOT! I [u]love[/u] having a house. When the expansion opened on the Public Test Server I discovered I could move items exactly how I liked, not simply placing things in a house. I almost fell out of my chair! I made this giant mushroom staircase with a cute little deck on top. When Storm Legion went live, I was either building or earning reputation points for items; we had very few items to chose from at that time and many were found on reputation vendors. Grinding rep has the natural consequences of leveling you, so I always seem to get max level very easily.

[b]What drove you to the insanity of starting up the Dimension Addicts site?[/b]

Many years back, I was sick with a fever of 105 for almost two weeks. When I didn't die, which was amazing in itself, I very quickly discovered many things were not "right" anymore. I couldn't control my emotions. I ended up having super high empathy, I couldn't do simple math, my memory was completely messed up and I got confused easily.

The worst part of all was that I could no longer understand what I was trying to look for on a website if it had the wrong colors, was too cluttered, or had articles jumbled everywhere. In turn, my illness made other things pop - I see things much differently now. It is like everything had a beauty intensified. With colors and smells, I could see things anew. Looking at rings on a tree stump, for example, I could see the glimmer in the wood that I never noticed previously.

Dimension items were easy for me to look at and find other uses for, beyond the obvious. I could visualize [u]so[/u] much to be made out of the simplest items. With Dimensions, I found something I could do that I could make as beautiful as the world around me for the first time. 

Then came the "Joys of Dimensions" contest by Trion. You could win these beautiful [url=http://dimensionaddicts.com/node/392]Prize Blooming Faer Cages[/url]. I wanted them soooo badly that it hurt inside thinking I couldn't get them. At that time, you could only have one dimension per character, so I ripped my dimension apart and started over ~Sweethearts~@deepwood was born. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/95976e59632e7baea766cc0c494cce611e821e68.jpg[/img]

When the contest was over I didn't know I had won anything. I started tearing down parts of my dim to make a bathroom in it, when up pops Elrar to let me know I had won the [u][b]grand prize[/b][/u]. I got my CAGES - I was jumping for joy. I was also informed I had won a computer... which took a while to sink in.

I grew up with the internet being very laggy. I didn't know it was [u]not[/u] normal to stutter through a game. I was playing Rift at 1 frame every 1 to 3 seconds. I was here when I was there. That was normal to me and I thought everyone played that way. When I received that computer, my tech jumped 15 years in one go. I could move dim items quickly and accurately. I had to build another dimension.

Because of my memory issues, I needed to use sites to tell me where items were, and what they were. Unfortunately, I was unable to understand the sites and ended crying out of frustration. Our friend Courdilla suggested that I make my own database so I could control the colors and how the items are listed. I laughed. I thought he was being funny and trying to make me feel better. I knew that making a database was impossible because I didn't know the first thing about it. My husband and Courdilla said they could put the hard stuff together for me and I just needed to add the items. They said [u]that[/u] was actually the hard part because it was time intensive.

At that time a group of us had been calling each other "dimension addicts" and someone made the chat channel in game a few days before, so I said let us call it RiftDimensionAddicts for fun. At this point, it was just going to be my personal space. So I made colors that worked for me and played at making a banner. It was just something fun to decorate and set up. I started adding images and learned simple Photoshop. I was learning new stuff, with help of many sticky notes. There were sticky notes [u]everywhere[/u]. So many that my husband found a program called Sticky Notes just so I could keep them digital and off the floor. I was having so much fun. When it was done, it looked nice, so Courd suggested I share it with people. It was ok, even though we had 2 dim item sites already; it was something I could share with my friends.

Little did I know how many items would be added in the future, how many times the prices would change, or that the item names themselves would change.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/a72d1e131823e01cfb3f28a84e0bf4a9715d647a.jpg[/img]

[b]How long do you spend on the site? Do you get any support from Trion staff on info and upcoming items?[/b]

Making the initial site took about a week or two. The updates however - some take longer to add than it took to make the site itself! Some updates we've had consisted of double what we had in the beginning. So I spend countless hours finding and adding each item. In the beginning, I had to find EVERY item in the game on my own to add it.

My first help from Trion was Morgana. I was so scared to ask her, but I needed help with getting a guild high enough to get some images of the guild dims. My stomach was turning and I was shaking scared, but I did it, and survived! Then Morticus opened communication channels to the dimensioneers. This helped so much - we were amazed by him and his help. Then in comes Tacitus, who just threw the doors wide open with "Here I am what do you need? I'm here to answer any question you may have, to fix anything I can, and be here for all you dimensionerds." Tacitus has been invaluable to all of us. He takes extra care to help me find or understand where something can be found so I can add it. Brasse is always there with her support and kindness anytime I need her, too. I can not even begin to describe how grateful I am to everyone on the staff who takes the time to answer my questions and needs.


[b]Are you among the first to submit Dimension bugs? Are you part of a group of likeminded Dim folks?[/b]

I do spend a lot of time on the PTS looking for dim bugs. Sometimes I don't realize its a bug and just say something. I am always there the second I know the PTS has been updated with dim items.

I love being part of the dimensionaddicts channel in game. It is somewhere that all us dimensionerds can get together and get help and be help for others. Anyone can join it and chat with us.

 

[b]How can other players help keep Dimension Addicts going?[/b]

Be sure to send me an email through the "contact us" button if you see any wrong information. I misspell, miss items, prices change, names change. I cant catch it all!

Also, we added a donate button to the front page. Because the database is so extensive we have to use a paid hosting service. Most sites offset this by adding advertisements to their pages. With the nature of why the site was created that won't work. If you can't donate its ok, don't feel bad!
I would just like to say Thank You to everyone over the last 5 years with your support and kindness. Here's to 5 more and beyond!

 

[b]What is your one piece of advice for all RIFT players?[/b]

Always remember:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/d4e95a796d2085f3c96bec2472cf52b12cc84205.png[/img]

notes.notes:

RIFT turns [b]7[/b] this year, and the Carnival folk are ready to celebrate with you!

[u][b]Seven years has flown by in the blink of an eye[/b][/u] - let's mark the occasion with all of our traditional Carnival events in Tempest Bay. We welcome all Live server players to grab a piece of 7 Year birthday cake and join the celebrations!

Wait up, say Prime server players... Tempest Bay? We haven't [u]found[/u] Tempest Bay yet! Ahhh, very true, though you've clearly heard rumors of the fun going on there, like echoes from a past life. Likewise, a traveling merchant has heard of this new, far off land called Vigil and is even now packing up his mule train to bring you a taste of Carnival! Look for Winachuck Maguck in Sanctum and Meridian. Yes, he [u]has[/u] mastered the arcane art of being in two places at once!

[h1][u]Carnival runs from March 15th at 3:30 PM Pacific (22:30 UTC) to April 5th at 3:30 PM Pacific (22:30 UTC).[/u][/h1]

[h1]We are pleased to show off our brand new Carnival items for 2018![/h1]
[h1]Available for event currency:[/h1]
[list]
 	[*]An adorable carousel-style Pegasus companion pet named [b][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4x55b8vMpgg&feature=youtu.be]Celeste[/url]![/b][/*]
 	[*]Cavort in stylish and colorful [b]carnival-style masks[/b], newly designed for this season[/*]
 	[*]Feeling bubbly? Apply the new [b]Celebratory[/b] or [b]Prismatic weapon rune[/b]![/*]
 	[*]Feel like throwing around some virtual coin? Use the [b]Golden[/b] or [b]Silver rune of Wealth[/b]![/*]
 	[*]Save some cake for your Dimension - the [b]Primal Rebirthday Cake[/b] has unlimited shelf life![/*]
 	[*]Earn a new [b]Raid Tier 2 Earring for lvl 70s[/b] (RIFT Live only)[/*]
 	[*]...and of course, the [b]7th Anniversary Cape[/b]![/*]
[/list]
 
[h1]Available on the RIFT store for credits:[/h1]
Glorious new [b][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4eRoS4WWkeA&feature=youtu.be]Wings of the Archfey[/url][/b] - make your own Carnival parade while wearing these beauties!

And without further ado, the mount you've all been waiting for... [u]no lockbox[/u], offered direct, fresh from the Plane of Life with a puff of helium...
[h1]Greeñata![/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/f2213664d8e591e2f3a9ce908a7e1724ba80cd01.jpg[/img]

Never has Greenscale been more plumpy, soft and loveable than in this unique, floating, mount form.
Best of all, every Telaran race rides Greeñata in a different way. Pictured above, the graceful form assumed by male Dwarves.

[b]Post your [u]#Greeñata[/u] pics @RIFTgame, on the forums, or on Facebook![/b]
See you for Carnival!
RIFT ON!
